title_en: Intrinsic factors responsible for brittle versus ductile nature of refractory high-entropy alloys
title_zh: 决定难熔高熵合金脆性与韧性本质的内在因素
abstract_en: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) are of interest for ultrahigh-temperature applications. To overcome their drawbacks - low-temperature brittleness and poor creep strength at high temperatures - improved fundamental understanding is needed. Using experiments, theory, and modeling, we investigated prototypical body-centered cubic (BCC) RHEAs, TiZrHfNbTa and VNbMoTaW. The former is compressible to 77 K, whereas the latter is not below 298 K. Hexagonal close-packed (HCP) elements in TiZrHfNbTa lower its dislocation core energy, increase lattice distortion, and lower its shear modulus relative to VNbMoTaW whose elements are all BCC. Screw dislocations dominate TiZrHfNbTa plasticity, but equal numbers of edges and screws exist in VNbTaMoW. Dislocation cores are compact in VNbTaMoW and extended in TiZrHfNbTa, and different macroscopic slip planes are activated in the two RHEAs, which we attribute to the concentration of HCP elements. Our findings demonstrate how ductility and strength can be controlled through the ratio of HCP to BCC elements in RHEAs.
abstract_zh: 难熔高熵合金（RHEA）在超高温应用中备受关注。为克服其低温脆性与高温蠕变强度差的缺陷，需要更深入的基础理解。作者结合实验、理论与模拟研究了原型体心立方（BCC）RHEA——TiZrHfNbTa与VNbMoTaW。前者可压缩至77 K，后者在298 K以下则不可压缩。TiZrHfNbTa中的密排六方（HCP）元素降低其位错核心能、增大晶格畸变并降低剪切模量（相对于全BCC元素的VNbMoTaW）。螺型位错主导TiZrHfNbTa塑性，而VNbTaMoW中刃型与螺型位错数量相当；VNbTaMoW位错核紧凑、TiZrHfNbTa位错核扩展，两者激活不同的宏观滑移面。
summary_zh: 结合实验与理论揭示TiZrHfNbTa中HCP元素降低位错核心能、增大晶格畸变并降低剪切模量使其低温可塑，阐明难熔高熵合金脆-韧本征差异源于位错核结构与滑移面的不同。

title_en: Rejuvenation as the origin of planar defects in the CrCoNi medium entropy alloy
title_zh: 回春作为CrCoNi中熵合金平面缺陷的起源
abstract_en: High or medium- entropy alloys (HEAs/MEAs) are multi-principal element alloys with equal atomic elemental composition, some of which have shown record-breaking mechanical performance. However, the link between short-range order (SRO) and the exceptional mechanical properties of these alloys has remained elusive. The local destruction of SRO by dislocation glide has been predicted to lead to a rejuvenated state with increased entropy and free energy, creating softer zones within the matrix and planar fault boundaries that enhance the ductility, but this has not been verified. Here, we integrate in situ nanomechanical testing with energy-filtered four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) and directly observe the rejuvenation during cyclic mechanical loading in single crystal CrCoNi at room temperature. Surprisingly, stacking faults (SFs) and twin boundaries (TBs) are reversible in initial cycles but become irreversible after a thousand cycles, indicating SF energy reduction and rejuvenation. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation further reveals that the local breakdown of SRO in the MEA triggers these SF reversibility changes. As a result, the deformation features in HEAs/MEAs remain planar and highly localized to the rejuvenated planes, leading to the superior damage tolerance characteristic in this class of alloys.
abstract_zh: 高熵/中熵合金（HEA/MEA）是等原子成分的多主元合金，其中一些展现出破纪录的力学性能。然而短程有序（SRO）与这些合金优异力学性能之间的联系仍不明确。理论预测位错滑移对SRO的局部破坏会导致熵与自由能增加的回春态，在基体内形成较软区域与平面缺陷边界从而增强塑性，但此前未被验证。本文将原位纳米力学测试与能量过滤四维扫描透射电镜（4D-STEM）结合，在室温循环加载下直接观测到CrCoNi单晶中的回春现象，并发现层错与孪晶界的形成。
summary_zh: 通过原位纳米力学测试结合4D-STEM直接观测CrCoNi单晶循环加载中的"回春"现象，证实位错滑移局部破坏短程有序产生软化区与平面缺陷从而增强塑性。
subtopic: 变形机制 / 位错·孪生

title_en: Ultrastrong and ductile steel welds achieved by fine interlocking microstructures with film-like retained austenite
title_zh: 通过含膜状残余奥氏体的细互锁组织实现超强高韧钢焊缝
abstract_en: The degradation of mechanical properties caused by grain coarsening or the formation of brittle phases during welding reduces the longevity of products. Here, we report advances in the weld quality of ultra-high strength steels by utilizing Nb and Cr instead of Ni. Sole addition of Cr, as an alternative to Ni, has limitations in developing fine weld microstructure, while it is revealed that the coupling effects of Nb and Cr additions make a finer interlocking weld microstructures with a higher fraction of retained austenite due to the decrease in austenite to acicular ferrite and bainite transformation temperature and carbon activity. As a result, an alloying design with Nb and Cr creates ultrastrong and ductile steel welds with enhanced tensile properties, impact toughness, and fatigue strength, at 45% lower material costs and lower environmental impact by removing Ni.
abstract_zh: 焊接过程中晶粒粗化或脆性相形成导致的力学性能退化会缩短产品寿命。本文报道利用Nb和Cr替代Ni提升超高强度钢焊缝质量的进展。单独添加Cr替代Ni在形成细焊缝组织方面存在局限，而Nb与Cr的耦合作用因降低奥氏体向针状铁素体、贝氏体的转变温度及碳活度，形成更细的互锁焊缝组织与更高比例的残余奥氏体。结果表明Nb-Cr合金设计在材料成本降低45%、去除Ni降低环境影响的同时，制备出兼具优异拉伸性能、冲击韧性与疲劳强度的超强高韧钢焊缝。
summary_zh: 用Nb+Cr替代Ni细化焊缝互锁组织并提高膜状残余奥氏体比例，使超高强钢焊缝在材料成本降低45%的同时兼具高强度、塑性、冲击韧性与疲劳强度。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: Ultrauniform, strong, and ductile 3D-printed titanium alloy through bifunctional alloy design
title_zh: 通过双功能合金设计实现超均匀、高强度且高塑性的3D打印钛合金
abstract_en: Coarse columnar grains and heterogeneously distributed phases commonly form in metallic alloys produced by three-dimensional (3D) printing and are often considered undesirable because they can impart nonuniform and inferior mechanical properties. We demonstrate a design strategy to unlock consistent and enhanced properties directly from 3D printing. Using Ti-5Al-5Mo-5V-3Cr as a model alloy, we show that adding molybdenum (Mo) nanoparticles promotes grain refinement during solidification and suppresses the formation of phase heterogeneities during solid-state thermal cycling. The microstructural change because of the bifunctional additive results in uniform mechanical properties and simultaneous enhancement of both strength and ductility. We demonstrate how this alloy can be modified by a single component to address unfavorable microstructures, providing a pathway to achieve desirable mechanical characteristics directly from 3D printing.
abstract_zh: 3D打印金属合金中常形成粗大柱状晶与非均匀分布的相，通常被认为不利，因其会导致非均匀且较差的力学性能。本文展示一种可直接从3D打印中获得一致且增强性能的设计策略：以Ti-5Al-5Mo-5V-3Cr为模型合金，添加钼（Mo）纳米颗粒在凝固时促进晶粒细化，并在固态热循环中抑制相异质性形成。这种双功能添加剂引起的组织变化带来均匀的力学性能并同时提升强度与塑性，展示了如何通过单一组分改性合金以解决不利组织。
summary_zh: 在Ti-5Al-5Mo-5V-3Cr中添加Mo纳米颗粒，凝固时细化晶粒并抑制固态热循环中的相异质性，使3D打印钛合金获得均匀且同步提升的强度与塑性。

title_en: A strong fracture-resistant high-entropy alloy with nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure intrinsically toughened by 3D-printing
title_zh: 通过3D打印本征增韧、具纳米桥蜂窝组织的强抗断裂高熵合金
abstract_en: Abstract Strengthening materials via conventional “top-down” processes generally involves restricting dislocation movement by precipitation or grain refinement, which invariably restricts the movement of dislocations away from, or towards, a crack tip, thereby severely compromising their fracture resistance. In the present study, a high-entropy alloy Al 0.5 CrCoFeNi is produced by the laser powder-bed fusion process, a “bottom-up” additive manufacturing process similar to how nature builds structures, with the microstructure resembling a nano-bridged honeycomb structure consisting of a face-centered cubic ( fcc ) matrix and an interwoven hexagonal net of an ordered body-centered cubic B2 phase. While the B2 phase, combined with high-dislocation density and solid-solution strengthening, provides strength to the material, the nano-bridges of dislocations connecting the fcc cells, i.e ., the channels between the B2 phase on the cell boundaries, provide highways for dislocation movement away from the crack tip. Consequently, the nature-inspired microstructure imparts the material with an excellent combination of strength and toughness.
abstract_zh: 传统"自上而下"工艺通过析出或晶粒细化限制位错运动来强化材料，但这不可避免地限制了位错离开或趋向裂尖的运动，从而严重损害其抗断裂性。本文用激光粉末床熔融"自下而上"增材制造工艺制备Al0.5CrCoFeNi高熵合金，其组织类似纳米桥蜂窝结构，由面心立方（fcc）基体与有序体心立方B2相交织的六方网构成。B2相结合高位错密度与固溶强化提供强度，而连接fcc胞的位错纳米桥提供本征断裂韧性。
summary_zh: 用激光粉末床熔融制备Al0.5CrCoFeNi高熵合金，形成FCC基体与B2相交织的纳米桥蜂窝组织，B2相与固溶强化提供强度、位错纳米桥提供本征断裂韧性。

title_en: Biodegradable Zn‐5Dy Alloy with Enhanced Osteo/Angio‐Genic Activity and Osteointegration Effect via Regulation of SIRT4‐Dependent Mitochondrial Function
title_zh: 通过调控SIRT4依赖的线粒体功能增强成骨/血管生成活性与骨整合的可降解Zn-5Dy合金
abstract_en: Zinc (Zn)-dysprosium (Dy) binary alloys are promising biodegradable bone fracture fixation implants owing to their attractive biodegradability and mechanical properties. However, their clinical application is a challenge for bone fracture healing, due to the lack of Zn-Dy alloys with tailored proper bio-mechanical and osteointegration properties for bone regeneration. A Zn-5Dy alloy with high strength and ductility and a degradation rate aligned with the bone remodeling cycle is developed. Here, mechanical stability is further confirmed, proving that Zn-5Dy alloy can resist aging in the degradation process, thus meeting the mechanical requirements of fracture fixation. In vitro cellular experiments reveal that the Zn-5Dy alloy enhances osteogenesis and angiogenesis by elevating SIRT4-mediated mitochondrial function. In vivo Micro-CT, SEM-EDS, and immunohistochemistry analyses further indicate good biosafety, suitable biodegradation rate, and great osteointegration of Zn-5Dy alloy during bone healing, which also depends on the upregulation of SIRT4-mediated mitochondrial events. Overall, the study is the first to report a Zn-5Dy alloy that exerts remarkable osteointegration properties and has a strong potential to promote bone healing. Furthermore, the results highlight the importance of mitochondrial modulation and shall guide the future development of mitochondria-targeting materials in enhancing bone fracture healing.
abstract_zh: 锌（Zn）-镝（Dy）二元合金因其良好的生物降解性与力学性能，是有前景的可降解骨折固定植入材料。然而其临床应用因缺乏具有合适生物力学与骨整合性能的Zn-Dy合金而受限。本文开发出兼具高强度、塑性及与骨重塑周期匹配的降解速率的Zn-5Dy合金，并证实其力学稳定性——可抵抗降解过程中的老化，满足骨折固定的力学要求。体外细胞实验表明Zn-5Dy合金通过提升SIRT4介导的线粒体功能增强成骨与血管生成；体内Micro-CT、SEM-EDS与免疫组化进一步证实其骨整合效果。
summary_zh: （偏生物医用）开发兼具高强度、塑性与匹配骨重塑周期降解速率的可降解Zn-5Dy合金，通过SIRT4介导线粒体功能促进成骨与血管生成，改善骨折固定植入体骨整合。

title_zh: 负混合焓固溶体实现高强度与高塑性

title_en: Interpretable Predicting Creep Rupture Life of Superalloys: Enhanced by Domain‐Specific Knowledge
title_zh: 可解释地预测高温合金蠕变断裂寿命：领域知识增强
abstract_en: Evaluating and understanding the effect of manufacturing processes on the creep performance in superalloys poses a significant challenge due to the intricate composition involved. This study presents a machine-learning strategy capable of evaluating the effect of the heat treatment process on the creep performance of superalloys and predicting creep rupture life with high accuracy. This approach integrates classification and regression models with domain-specific knowledge. The physical constraints lead to significantly enhanced prediction accuracy of the classification and regression models. Moreover, the heat treatment process is evaluated as the most important descriptor by integrating machine learning with superalloy creep theory. The heat treatment design of Waspaloy alloy is used as the experimental validation. The improved heat treatment leads to a significant enhancement in creep performance (5.5 times higher than the previous study). The research provides novel insights for enhancing the precision of predicting creep rupture life in superalloys, with the potential to broaden its applicability to the study of the effects of heat treatment processes on other properties. Furthermore, it offers auxiliary support for the utilization of machine learning in the design of heat treatment processes of superalloys.
abstract_zh: 由于成分复杂，评估与理解制造工艺对高温合金蠕变性能的影响极具挑战。本研究提出一种机器学习策略，能评估热处理工艺对高温合金蠕变性能的影响并高精度预测蠕变断裂寿命。该方法将分类与回归模型和领域专门知识相结合，物理约束显著提升了分类与回归模型的预测精度。此外，通过将机器学习与高温合金蠕变理论结合，热处理工艺被评估为最重要的描述符。以Waspaloy合金的热处理设计作为实验验证，改进的热处理显著提升蠕变性能。
summary_zh: 提出融合领域知识的机器学习策略，将分类与回归模型结合物理约束高精度预测高温合金蠕变断裂寿命，并识别热处理为最重要因素，经Waspaloy实验验证。
subtopic: 计算 / 机器学习设计

title_en: Soft Self‐Healing Robot Driven by New Micro Two‐Way Shape Memory Alloy Spring (Adv. Sci. 2/2024)
title_zh: 由新型微型双程形状记忆合金弹簧驱动的软体自愈合机器人（Adv. Sci. 2/2024封面）
abstract_en: Soft Self-Healing Robot Soft robotic bodies are susceptible to mechanical fatigue, punctures, electrical breakdown, and ageing. Chaoying Wan, Min Pan, and co-workers create a soft self-healing robot using a thermoplastic MG-SBS elastomer tube fabricated by melt-extrusion to allow the robot to self-heal autonomously at room temperature. After repeated damage and being separated into several parts, the robot is able to heal and enable almost complete recovery of robot performance. More details can be found in article number 2305163.
abstract_zh: 软体自愈合机器人：软体机器人本体易受机械疲劳、穿刺、电击穿与老化影响。Chaoying Wan、Min Pan等人利用熔融挤出制备的热塑性MG-SBS弹性体管制造软体自愈合机器人，使其可在室温下自主自愈合。在反复损伤并被分离为数块后，机器人能够自愈并几乎完全恢复性能。
summary_zh: （封面/非合金力学）介绍由新型微型双程形状记忆合金弹簧驱动、可室温自愈合的软体机器人。

title_en: Strong and ductile high temperature soft magnets through Widmanstätten precipitates
title_zh: 通过魏氏组织析出相实现强而韧的高温软磁材料
abstract_en: Fast growth of sustainable energy production requires massive electrification of transport, industry and households, with electrical motors as key components. These need soft magnets with high saturation magnetization, mechanical strength, and thermal stability to operate efficiently and safely. Reconciling these properties in one material is challenging because thermally-stable microstructures for strength increase conflict with magnetic performance. Here, we present a material concept that combines thermal stability, soft magnetic response, and high mechanical strength. The strong and ductile soft ferromagnet is realized as a multicomponent alloy in which precipitates with a large aspect ratio form a Widmanstätten pattern. The material shows excellent magnetic and mechanical properties at high temperatures while the reference alloy with identical composition devoid of precipitates significantly loses its magnetization and strength at identical temperatures. The work provides a new avenue to develop soft magnets for high-temperature applications, enabling efficient use of sustainable electrical energy under harsh operating conditions.
abstract_zh: 可持续能源生产的快速增长需要交通、工业与家庭的大规模电气化，电动机是关键部件，其需要具有高饱和磁化强度、力学强度与热稳定性的软磁材料以高效安全运行。在一种材料中协调这些性能颇具挑战，因为提升强度所需的热稳定组织与磁性能相冲突。本文提出一种兼具热稳定性、软磁响应与高力学强度的材料概念：这种强而韧的软铁磁体是一种多组元合金，其中大长径比的析出相形成魏氏组织图案。该材料在高温下展现优异磁性与力学性能，而无析出相的同成分参比合金则显著逊色。
summary_zh: 提出在多组元合金中形成大长径比魏氏组织析出相的材料概念，兼顾热稳定性、软磁响应与高力学强度，高温下磁性与力学性能均优于无析出的同成分参比合金。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: Origin of age softening in the refractory high-entropy alloys
title_zh: 难熔高熵合金中时效软化的起源
abstract_en: Refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) are emerging materials with potential for use under extreme conditions. As a newly developed material system, a comprehensive understanding of their long-term stability under potential service temperatures remains to be established. This study examined a titanium-vanadium-niobium-tantalum alloy, a promising RHEA known for its superior high-temperature strength and room-temperature ductility. Using a combination of advanced analytical microscopies, Calculation of Phase Diagrams (CALPHAD) software, and nanoindentation, we investigated the evolution of its microstructure and mechanical properties upon aging at 700°C. Trace interstitials such as oxygen and nitrogen, initially contributing to solid solution strengthening, promote phase segregation during thermal aging. As a result of the depletion of solute interstitials within the metal matrix, a progressive softening is observed in the alloy as a function of aging time. This study, therefore, underscores the need for a better control of impurities in future development and application of RHEAs.
abstract_zh: 难熔高熵合金（RHEA）是有望用于极端条件的新兴材料。作为新开发的材料体系，其在潜在服役温度下的长期稳定性仍待建立。本研究考察了钛-钒-铌-钽合金——一种以优异高温强度与室温塑性著称的有前景RHEA。结合先进分析显微术、相图计算（CALPHAD）软件与纳米压痕，研究其在700°C时效时的组织与力学性能演变。氧、氮等痕量间隙原子初期贡献固溶强化，但在热时效期间促进相偏析，导致金属基体内溶质间隙原子耗尽，使硬度渐进下降。
summary_zh: 揭示Ti-V-Nb-Ta难熔高熵合金700°C时效软化的根源：氧氮等痕量间隙原子初期固溶强化，随后促进相偏析导致基体间隙原子耗尽，引起硬度渐进下降。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: Soft Self‐Healing Robot Driven by New Micro Two‐Way Shape Memory Alloy Spring
title_zh: 由新型微型双程形状记忆合金弹簧驱动的软体自愈合机器人
abstract_en: Soft robotic bodies are susceptible to mechanical fatigue, punctures, electrical breakdown, and aging, which can result in the degradation of performance or unexpected failure. To overcome these challenges, a soft self-healing robot is created using a thermoplastic methyl thioglycolate-modified styrene-butadiene-styrene (MG-SBS) elastomer tube fabricated by melt-extrusion, to allow the robot to self-heal autonomously at room temperature. After repeated damage and being separated into several parts, the robot is able to heal its stiffness and elongation to break to enable almost complete recovery of robot performance after being allowed to heal at room temperature for 24 h. The self-healing capability of the robot is examined across the material scale to robot scale by detailed investigations of the healing process, healing efficiency, mechanical characterization of the robot, and assessment of dynamic performance before and after healing. The self-healing robot is driven by a new micro two-way shape-memory alloy (TWSMA) spring actuator which achieved a crawling speed of 21.6 cm/min, equivalent to 1.57 body length per minute. An analytical model of the robot is created to understand the robot dynamics and to act as an efficient tool for self-healing robot design and optimization. This work therefore provides a new methodology to create efficient, robust, and damage-tolerant soft robots.
abstract_zh: 软体机器人本体易受机械疲劳、穿刺、电击穿与老化影响，可能导致性能退化或意外失效。为克服这些挑战，本文用熔融挤出制备的热塑性巯基乙酸甲酯改性苯乙烯-丁二烯-苯乙烯（MG-SBS）弹性体管制造软体自愈合机器人，使其可在室温下自主自愈合。反复损伤并被分离为数块后，机器人在室温下愈合24 h即可恢复刚度与断裂伸长率，几乎完全恢复性能。作者从材料尺度到机器人尺度详细研究了愈合过程、愈合效率与力学表征。
summary_zh: （非合金力学）用改性SBS弹性体管制备可室温自主自愈合的软体机器人，反复损伤甚至断裂后24 h内几乎完全恢复刚度、断裂伸长率与性能。

title_en: Room-temperature super-elongation in high-entropy alloy nanopillars
title_zh: 高熵合金纳米柱中的室温超延伸
abstract_en: Nanoscale small-volume metallic materials typically exhibit high strengths but often suffer from a lack of tensile ductility due to undesirable premature failure. Here, we report unusual room-temperature uniform elongation up to ~110% at a high flow stress of 0.6-1.0 GPa in single-crystalline <110>-oriented CoCrFeNi high-entropy alloy nanopillars with well-defined geometries. By combining high-resolution microscopy and large-scale atomistic simulations, we reveal that this ultrahigh uniform tensile ductility is attributed to spatial and synergistic coordination of deformation twinning and dislocation slip, which effectively promote deformation delocalization and delay necking failure. These joint and/or sequential activations of the underlying displacive deformation mechanisms originate from chemical compositional heterogeneities at the atomic level and resulting wide variations in generalized stacking fault energy and associated dislocation activities. Our work provides mechanistic insights into superplastic deformations of multiple-principal element alloys at the nanoscale and opens routes for designing nanodevices with high mechanical reliability.
abstract_zh: 纳米尺度小体积金属材料通常表现出高强度，但常因过早失效而缺乏拉伸塑性。本文报道在具明确几何形状的<110>取向CoCrFeNi高熵合金单晶纳米柱中，于0.6–1.0 GPa高流变应力下实现约110%的室温均匀延伸率。结合高分辨显微术与大规模原子模拟，揭示这种超高均匀拉伸塑性归因于变形孪生与位错滑移的空间协同配合，有效促进变形离域并延迟颈缩失效。这些位移型变形机制的联合/顺序激活源于原子层面的化学成分异质性。
summary_zh: 在<110>取向CoCrFeNi高熵合金单晶纳米柱中实现室温~110%均匀延伸率（0.6–1.0 GPa高流变应力），源于孪生与位错滑移协同促进变形离域、延迟颈缩失效。

title_en: Tailoring chemical composition of solid electrolyte interphase by selective dissolution for long-life micron-sized silicon anode
title_zh: 通过选择性溶解定制固态电解质界面化学成分以实现长寿命微米硅负极
abstract_en: Abstract Micron-sized Si anode promises a much higher theoretical capacity than the traditional graphite anode and more attractive application prospect compared to its nanoscale counterpart. However, its severe volume expansion during lithiation requires solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) with reinforced mechanical stability. Here, we propose a solvent-induced selective dissolution strategy to in situ regulate the mechanical properties of SEI. By introducing a high-donor-number solvent, gamma-butyrolactone, into conventional electrolytes, low-modulus components of the SEI, such as Li alkyl carbonates, can be selectively dissolved upon cycling, leaving a robust SEI mainly consisting of lithium fluoride and polycarbonates. With this strategy, raw micron-sized Si anode retains 87.5% capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C (1500 mA g−1, 25°C), which can be improved to >300 cycles with carbon-coated micron-sized Si anode. Furthermore, the Si||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 battery using the raw micron-sized Si anode with the selectively dissolved SEI retains 83.7% capacity after 150 cycles at 0.5 C (90 mA g−1). The selective dissolution effect for tailoring the SEI, as well as the corresponding cycling life of the Si anodes, is positively related to the donor number of the solvents, which highlights designing high-donor-number electrolytes as a guideline to tailor the SEI for stabilizing volume-changing alloying-type anodes in high-energy rechargeable batteries.
abstract_zh: 微米硅负极理论容量远高于传统石墨负极，应用前景也比纳米级硅更具吸引力。然而其锂化过程中严重的体积膨胀要求具有增强力学稳定性的固态电解质界面（SEI）。本文提出溶剂诱导选择性溶解策略原位调控SEI力学性能：向常规电解液引入高给体数溶剂γ-丁内酯，可选择性溶解SEI中的低模量组分（如烷基碳酸锂），留下主要由氟化锂与聚碳酸酯构成的坚固SEI。该策略使原始微米硅负极在0.5 C下循环100次后保持87.5%容量，配碳包覆可提升至300次以上。
summary_zh: （非合金力学/电池）提出溶剂诱导选择性溶解策略原位调控硅负极SEI力学稳定性，微米硅负极循环稳定性显著提升。

title_en: Additive manufacturing of alloys with programmable microstructure and properties
title_zh: 具可编程微观组织与性能的合金增材制造
abstract_en: In metallurgy, mechanical deformation is essential to engineer the microstructure of metals and to tailor their mechanical properties. However, this practice is inapplicable to near-net-shape metal parts produced by additive manufacturing (AM), since it would irremediably compromise their carefully designed geometries. In this work, we show how to circumvent this limitation by controlling the dislocation density and thermal stability of a steel alloy produced by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) technology. We show that by manipulating the alloy's solidification structure, we can 'program' recrystallization upon heat treatment without using mechanical deformation. When employed site-specifically, our strategy enables designing and creating complex microstructure architectures that combine recrystallized and non-recrystallized regions with different microstructural features and properties. We show how this heterogeneity may be conducive to materials with superior performance compared to those with monolithic microstructure. Our work inspires the design of high-performance metal parts with artificially engineered microstructures by AM.
abstract_zh: 在冶金学中，机械变形对于调控金属组织、定制其力学性能至关重要。然而这一做法不适用于增材制造（AM）生产的近净成形金属零件，因其会不可逆地破坏精心设计的几何形状。本文展示如何规避这一局限：通过控制激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）技术制备的钢合金的位错密度与热稳定性——通过操控合金的凝固组织，可在不使用机械变形的情况下"编程"热处理时的再结晶。当位点特异性应用时，该策略可设计并创建结合再结晶区与非再结晶区、具不同组织特征与性能的复杂组织架构。
summary_zh: 通过操控激光粉末床熔融钢的凝固组织与位错密度、热稳定性，在无机械变形下"编程"热处理再结晶，实现结合再结晶与非再结晶区的复杂组织架构。
subtopic: 增材制造 / 加工–力学

title_en: Ideal plasticity and shape memory of nanolamellar high-entropy alloys
title_zh: 纳米层状高熵合金的理想塑性与形状记忆
abstract_en: Understanding the relationship among elemental compositions, nanolamellar microstructures, and mechanical properties enables the rational design of high-entropy alloys (HEAs). Here, we construct nanolamellar Al x CoCuFeNi HEAs with alternating high– and low–Al concentration layers and explore their mechanical properties using a combination of molecular dynamic simulation and density functional theory calculation. Our results show that the HEAs with nanolamellar structures exhibit ideal plastic behavior during uniaxial tensile loading, a feature not observed in homogeneous HEAs. This remarkable ideal plasticity is attributed to the unique deformation mechanisms of phase transformation coupled with dislocation nucleation and propagation in the high–Al concentration layers and the confinement and slip-blocking effect of the low–Al concentration layers. Unexpectedly, this ideal plasticity is fully reversible upon unloading, leading to a remarkable shape memory effect. Our work highlights the importance of nanolamellar structures in controlling the mechanical and functional properties of HEAs and presents a fascinating route for the design of HEAs for both functional and structural applications.
abstract_zh: 理解元素成分、纳米层状组织与力学性能之间的关系可实现高熵合金（HEA）的理性设计。本文构建了交替高、低Al浓度层的纳米层状AlxCoCuFeNi高熵合金，结合分子动力学模拟与密度泛函理论计算探究其力学性能。结果表明具纳米层状结构的HEA在单轴拉伸加载下表现出理想塑性行为，这是均质HEA所不具备的。这种理想塑性归因于高Al浓度层中相变与位错形核、扩展的耦合，以及低Al浓度层的约束与阻滑效应。
summary_zh: 用分子动力学与DFT构建交替高低Al浓度的纳米层状AlxCoCuFeNi高熵合金，展现单轴拉伸下的理想塑性，源于高Al层相变+位错与低Al层约束滑移的协同。
subtopic: 变形机制 / 位错·孪生

title_en: Unlocking the Potential of CuAgZr Metallic Glasses: A Comprehensive Exploration with Combinatorial Synthesis, High‐Throughput Characterization, and Machine Learning
title_zh: 释放CuAgZr金属玻璃的潜力：组合合成、高通量表征与机器学习的综合探索
abstract_en: In this work, the CuAgZr metallic glasses (MGs) are investigated, a promising material for biomedical applications due to their high strength, corrosion resistance, and antibacterial activity. Using an integrated approach of combinatorial synthesis, high-throughput characterization, and machine learning (ML), the mechanical properties of CuAgZr MGs are efficiently explored. The investigation find that post-deposition oxidation in inter-columnar regions with looser packing causes high oxygen content in Cu-rich regions, significantly affecting the alloys' mechanical behavior. The study also reveals that nanoscale structural features greatly impact plastic yielding and flow in the alloys. ML algorithms are tested, and the multi-layer perceptron algorithm produced satisfactory predictions for the alloys' hardness of untested alloys, providing valuable clues for future research. The work demonstrates the potential of using combinatorial synthesis, high-throughput characterization, and ML techniques to facilitate the development of new MGs with improved strength and economic feasibility.
abstract_zh: 本文研究CuAgZr金属玻璃（MG）——一种因高强度、耐腐蚀与抗菌活性而在生物医学应用中有前景的材料。采用组合合成、高通量表征与机器学习（ML）的集成方法高效探索CuAgZr MG的力学性能。研究发现堆积较松的柱间区域沉积后氧化导致Cu富集区高氧含量，显著影响合金力学行为，纳米尺度结构特征极大影响合金的塑性屈服与流动。测试的多种ML算法中，多层感知机对未测试合金的硬度给出满意预测，为未来研究提供线索。
summary_zh: 用组合合成+高通量表征+机器学习高效探索CuAgZr金属玻璃力学性能，发现柱间氧化影响其力学行为，多层感知机可较好预测硬度。
subtopic: 计算 / 机器学习设计

title_en: Chemical inhomogeneity–induced profuse nanotwinning and phase transformation in AuCu nanowires
title_zh: 化学不均匀诱导AuCu纳米线中大量纳米孪生与相变
abstract_en: Nanosized metals usually exhibit ultrahigh strength but suffer from low homogeneous plasticity. The origin of a strength-ductility trade-off has been well studied for pure metals, but not for random solid solution (RSS) alloys. How RSS alloys accommodate plasticity and whether they can achieve synergy between high strength and superplasticity has remained unresolved. Here, we show that face-centered cubic (FCC) RSS AuCu alloy nanowires (NWs) exhibit superplasticity of ~260% and ultrahigh strength of ~6 GPa, overcoming the trade-off between strength and ductility. These excellent properties originate from profuse hexagonal close-packed (HCP) phase generation (2H and 4H phases), recurrence of reversible FCC-HCP phase transition, and zigzag-like nanotwin generation, which has rarely been reported before. Such a mechanism stems from the inherent chemical inhomogeneity, which leads to widely distributed and overlapping energy barriers for the concurrent activation of multiple plasticity mechanisms. This naturally implies a similar deformation behavior for other highly concentrated solid-solution alloys with multiple principal elements, such as high/medium-entropy alloys. Our findings shed light on the effect of chemical inhomogeneity on the plastic deformation mechanism of solid-solution alloys.
abstract_zh: 纳米金属通常表现出超高强度但均匀塑性低。强度-塑性倒置的起源在纯金属中已有充分研究，但随机固溶（RSS）合金尚未研究。RSS合金如何协调塑性、能否实现高强度与超塑性的协同仍未解决。本文表明面心立方（FCC）随机固溶AuCu合金纳米线展现约260%的超塑性与约6 GPa的超高强度，克服了强度-塑性倒置。这些优异性能源于大量密排六方（HCP）相（2H与4H相）生成、可逆FCC-HCP相变的反复发生及锯齿状纳米孪晶生成，此前鲜有报道。该机制源于固有化学不均匀性。
summary_zh: 揭示FCC随机固溶AuCu纳米线因化学不均匀诱发大量HCP相生成、可逆FCC-HCP相变及锯齿状纳米孪晶，实现~260%超塑性与~6 GPa超高强度，克服强塑性倒置。
subtopic: 变形机制 / 位错·孪生

title_en: Valence electron concentration as key parameter to control the fracture resistance of refractory high-entropy carbides
title_zh: 价电子浓度作为控制难熔高熵碳化物断裂抗力的关键参数
abstract_en: Although high-entropy carbides (HECs) have hardness often superior to that of parent compounds, their brittleness-a problem shared with most ceramics-has severely limited their reliability. Refractory HECs in particular are attracting considerable interest due to their unique combination of mechanical and physical properties, tunable over a vast compositional space. Here, combining statistics of crack formation in bulk specimens subject to mild, moderate, and severe nanoindentation loading with ab initio molecular dynamics simulations of alloys under tension, we show that the resistance to fracture of cubic-B1 HECs correlates with their valence electron concentration (VEC). Electronic structure analyses show that VEC ≳ 9.4 electrons per formula unit enhances alloy fracture resistance due to a facile rehybridization of electronic metallic states, which activates transformation plasticity at the yield point. Our work demonstrates a reliable strategy for computationally guided and rule-based (i.e., VEC) engineering of deformation mechanisms in high entropy, solid solution, and doped ceramics.
abstract_zh: 尽管高熵碳化物（HEC）硬度常优于母体化合物，但其脆性（与多数陶瓷共有的问题）严重限制了可靠性。难熔HEC因其在广阔成分空间可调的独特力学与物理性能组合尤受关注。本文结合块体试样在轻、中、重纳米压痕载荷下裂纹形成统计与拉伸下合金的从头算分子动力学模拟，表明立方B1型HEC的抗断裂性与其价电子浓度（VEC）相关。电子结构分析表明VEC≳9.4电子/化学式单位时，金属态的易再杂化增强抗断裂性，激活相变塑性。
summary_zh: 结合裂纹统计与从头算分子动力学揭示立方B1高熵碳化物断裂抗力与价电子浓度相关，VEC≳9.4时金属态再杂化激活相变塑性以增强抗断裂。

title_en: Functionally Tailored Metal–Organic Framework Coatings for Mediating Ti Implant Osseointegration
title_zh: 功能定制的金属有机框架涂层介导钛植入体骨整合
abstract_en: Owing to their mechanical resilience and non-toxicity, titanium implants are widely applied as the major treatment modality for the clinical intervention against bone fractures. However, the intrinsic bioinertness of Ti and its alloys often impedes the effective osseointegration of the implants, leading to severe adverse complications including implant loosening, detachment, and secondary bone damage. Consequently, new Ti implant engineering strategies are urgently needed to improve their osseointegration after implantation. Remarkably, metalorganic frameworks (MOFs) are a class of novel synthetic material consisting of coordinated metal species and organic ligands, which have demonstrated a plethora of favorable properties for modulating the interfacial properties of Ti implants. This review comprehensively summarizes the recent progress in the development of MOF-coated Ti implants and highlights their potential utility for modulating the bio-implant interface to improve implant osseointegration, of which the discussions are outlined according to their physical traits, chemical composition, and drug delivery capacity. A perspective is also provided in this review regarding the current limitations and future opportunities of MOF-coated Ti implants for orthopedic applications. The insights in this review may facilitate the rational design of more advanced Ti implants with enhanced therapeutic performance and safety.
abstract_zh: 钛植入体因其力学韧性与无毒性，被广泛用作骨折临床干预的主要治疗手段。然而钛及其合金固有的生物惰性常阻碍植入体的有效骨整合，导致植入体松动、脱落与继发骨损伤等严重并发症，因此亟需新的钛植入体工程策略以改善植入后骨整合。金属有机框架（MOF）是由配位金属物种与有机配体构成的新型合成材料，展现出调控钛植入体界面性能的诸多有利特性。本综述全面总结了MOF涂层钛植入体的最新进展。
summary_zh: （综述/非合金力学）综述金属有机框架涂层介导钛植入体骨整合的研究进展。

title_en: Large Improvement of Thermoelectric Performance by Magnetism in Co‐Based Full‐Heusler Alloys
title_zh: 磁性大幅提升Co基全霍伊斯勒合金的热电性能
abstract_en: Abstract Full‐Heusler alloys (fHAs) exhibit high mechanical strength with earth‐abundant elements, but their metallic properties tend to display small electron diffusion thermopower, limiting potential applications as excellent thermoelectric (TE) materials. Here, it is demonstrated that the Co‐based fHAs Co 2 X Al ( X = Ti, V, Nb) exhibit relatively high thermoelectric performance due to spin and charge coupling. Thermopower contributions from different magnetic mechanisms, including spin fluctuation and magnon drag are extracted. A significant contribution to thermopower from magnetism compared to that from electron diffusion is demonstrated. In Co 2 TiAl, the contribution to thermopower from spin fluctuation is higher than that from electron diffusion, resulting in an increment of 280 µW m −1 K −2 in the power factor value. Interestingly, the thermopower contribution from magnon drag can reach up to ‐47 µV K −1 , which is over 2400% larger than the electron diffusion thermopower. The power factor of Co 2 TiAl can reach 4000 µW m −1 K −2 which is comparable to that of conventional semiconducting TE materials. Moreover, the corresponding figure of merit zT can reach ≈0.1 at room temperature, which is significantly larger than that of traditional metallic materials. The work shows a promising unconventional way to create and optimize TE materials by introducing magnetism.
abstract_zh: 全霍伊斯勒合金（fHA）以地球丰富元素展现高力学强度，但其金属性往往表现出较小的电子扩散热电势，限制了其作为优异热电材料的应用潜力。本文证明Co基fHA——Co2XAl（X=Ti、V、Nb）因自旋与电荷耦合展现相对较高的热电性能。作者提取了自旋涨落、磁振子拖曳等不同磁机制对热电势的贡献，证明磁性对热电势的贡献显著大于电子扩散。在Co2TiAl中，自旋涨落对热电势的贡献高于电子扩散，功率因子提升280 µW m^-1 K^-2。
summary_zh: （非合金力学/热电）证明Co基全霍伊斯勒合金Co2XAl因自旋-电荷耦合具较高热电性能，自旋涨落与磁振子拖曳显著贡献热电势。

title_en: A Novel Al–Cu Composite with Ultra‐High Strength at 350 °C via Dual‐Phase Particle Reinforced Submicron‐Structure
title_zh: 通过双相颗粒增强亚微米结构实现350°C下超高强度的新型Al–Cu复合材料
abstract_en: Abstract Thermal stability determines a material's ability to maintain its performance at desired service temperatures. This is especially important for aluminum (Al) alloys, which are widely used in the commercial sector. Herein, an ultra‐strong and heat‐resistant Al‐Cu composite is fabricated with a structure of nano‐AlN and submicron‐Al2O3 particles uniformly distributed in the matrix. At 350 °C, the (8.2AlN+1Al2O3)p/Al‐0.9Cu composite achieves a high strength of 187 MPa along with a 4.6% ductility under tension. The high strength and good ductility benefit from strong pinning effect on dislocation motion and grain boundary sliding by uniform dispersion of nano‐AlN particles, in conjunction with the precipitation of Guinier–Preston (GP) zones, enhancing strain hardening capacity during plastic deformation. This work can expand the selection of Al–Cu composites for potential applications at service temperatures as high as ≈350 °C.
abstract_zh: 热稳定性决定材料在所需服役温度下保持性能的能力，这对广泛用于商业领域的铝合金尤为重要。本文制备了纳米AlN与亚微米Al2O3颗粒均匀分布于基体的超强耐热Al-Cu复合材料。350°C下，(8.2AlN+1Al2O3)p/Al-0.9Cu复合材料在拉伸下实现187 MPa的高强度与4.6%塑性。高强度与良好塑性得益于纳米AlN颗粒均匀弥散对位错运动与晶界滑移的强钉扎，以及Guinier–Preston（GP）区析出增强塑性变形中的应变硬化能力。
summary_zh: 制备纳米AlN+亚微米Al2O3颗粒均匀分布的Al-Cu复合材料，350°C下强度达187 MPa、塑性4.6%，源于颗粒对位错的强钉扎、晶界滑移抑制及GP区析出增强加工硬化。

title_en: Evolution from Bioinert to Bioresorbable: In Vivo Comparative Study of Additively Manufactured Metal Bone Scaffolds
title_zh: 从生物惰性到生物可吸收的演变：增材制造金属骨支架的体内对比研究
abstract_en: Additively manufactured scaffolds offer significant potential for treating bone defects, owing to their porous, customizable architecture and functionalization capabilities. Although various biomaterials have been investigated, metals - the most successful orthopedic material - have yet to yield satisfactory results. Conventional bio-inert metals, such as titanium (Ti) and its alloys, are widely used for fixation devices and reconstructive implants, but their non-bioresorbable nature and the mechanical property mismatch with human bones limit their application as porous scaffolds for bone regeneration. Advancements in additive manufacturing have facilitated the use of bioresorbable metals, including magnesium (Mg), zinc (Zn), and their alloys, as porous scaffolds via Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) technology. This in vivo study presents a comprehensive, side-by-side comparative analysis of the interactions between bone regeneration and additively manufactured bio-inert/bioresorbable metal scaffolds, as well as their therapeutic outcomes. The research offers an in-depth understanding of the metal scaffold-assisted bone healing process, illustrating that Mg and Zn scaffolds contribute to the bone healing process in distinct ways, but ultimately deliver superior therapeutic outcomes compared to Ti scaffolds. These findings suggest that bioresorbable metal scaffolds hold considerable promise for the clinical treatment of bone defects in the near future.
abstract_zh: 增材制造支架因其多孔、可定制的架构与功能化能力，在治疗骨缺损方面潜力巨大。尽管已研究多种生物材料，但作为最成功的骨科材料，金属尚未取得满意结果。传统生物惰性金属（如钛及其合金）广泛用于固定装置与重建植入体，但其非生物可吸收性及与人骨的力学性能失配限制了其作为骨再生多孔支架的应用。增材制造的进步促进了镁、锌及其合金等生物可吸收金属通过激光粉末床熔融（L-PBF）技术作为多孔支架的应用。本体内研究对其进行了全面的并列对比分析。
summary_zh: （偏生物医用）体内对比研究增材制造钛与可降解镁、锌合金多孔骨支架，探讨从生物惰性到生物可吸收的演变及力学-骨再生匹配。

title_en: Gibbs Adsorption and Zener Pinning Enable Mechanically Robust High‐Performance Bi 2 Te 3 ‐Based Thermoelectric Devices
title_zh: Gibbs吸附与Zener钉扎实现力学稳健的高性能Bi2Te3基热电器件
abstract_en: Abstract Bi 2 Te 3 ‐based alloys have great market demand in miniaturized thermoelectric (TE) devices for solid‐state refrigeration and power generation. However, their poor mechanical properties increase the fabrication cost and decrease the service durability. Here, this work reports on strengthened mechanical robustness in Bi 2 Te 3 ‐based alloys due to thermodynamic Gibbs adsorption and kinetic Zener pinning at grain boundaries enabled by MgB 2 decomposition. These effects result in much‐refined grain size and twofold enhancement of the compressive strength and Vickers hardness in (Bi 0.5 Sb 1.5 Te 3 ) 0.97 (MgB 2 ) 0.03 compared with that of traditional powder‐metallurgy‐derived Bi 0.5 Sb 1.5 Te 3 . High mechanical properties enable excellent cutting machinability in the MgB 2 ‐added samples, showing no missing corners or cracks. Moreover, adding MgB 2 facilitates the simultaneous optimization of electron and phonon transport for enhancing the TE figure of merit (ZT). By further optimizing the Bi/Sb ratio, the sample (Bi 0.4 Sb 1.6 Te 3 ) 0.97 (MgB 2 ) 0.03 shows a maximum ZT of ≈1.3 at 350 K and an average ZT of 1.1 within 300–473 K. As a consequence, robust TE devices with an energy conversion efficiency of 4.2% at a temperature difference of 215 K are fabricated. This work paves a new way for enhancing the machinability and durability of TE materials, which is especially promising for miniature devices.
abstract_zh: Bi2Te3基合金在用于固态制冷与发电的微型热电（TE）器件中有巨大市场需求，但其较差的力学性能增加制造成本、降低服役耐久性。本文报道通过MgB2分解引发的热力学Gibbs吸附与动力学Zener钉扎在晶界处增强Bi2Te3基合金力学稳健性：这些效应使晶粒明显细化，(Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3)0.97(MgB2)0.03的压缩强度与维氏硬度较传统粉末冶金Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3提升两倍。高力学性能使MgB2添加样品具优异切削加工性，无缺角或裂纹，同时MgB2还促进热电性能优化。
summary_zh: （偏热电/功能）通过MgB2分解引发的Gibbs吸附与Zener钉扎细化Bi2Te3基合金晶界，压缩强度与维氏硬度翻倍，兼顾优异切削加工性与热电性能。

title_en: Atomic motifs govern the decoration of grain boundaries by interstitial solutes
title_zh: 原子基元主导间隙溶质对晶界的装饰
abstract_en: Grain boundaries, the two-dimensional defects between differently oriented crystals, tend to preferentially attract solutes for segregation. Solute segregation has a significant effect on the mechanical and transport properties of materials. At the atomic level, however, the interplay of structure and composition of grain boundaries remains elusive, especially with respect to light interstitial solutes like B and C. Here, we use Fe alloyed with B and C to exploit the strong interdependence of interface structure and chemistry via charge-density imaging and atom probe tomography methods. Direct imaging and quantifying of light interstitial solutes at grain boundaries provide insight into decoration tendencies governed by atomic motifs. We find that even a change in the inclination of the grain boundary plane with identical misorientation impacts grain boundary composition and atomic arrangement. Thus, it is the smallest structural hierarchical level, the atomic motifs, that controls the most important chemical properties of the grain boundaries. This insight not only closes a missing link between the structure and chemical composition of such defects but also enables the targeted design and passivation of the chemical state of grain boundaries to free them from their role as entry gates for corrosion, hydrogen embrittlement, or mechanical failure.
abstract_zh: 晶界是不同取向晶体间的二维缺陷，倾向于优先吸引溶质偏析。溶质偏析对材料的力学与输运性能有显著影响。然而在原子层面，晶界结构与成分的相互作用仍不明确，尤其对B、C等轻间隙溶质。本文用合金化B、C的Fe，通过电荷密度成像与原子探针层析方法，利用界面结构与化学的强相互依赖性，直接成像并定量晶界处的轻间隙溶质，揭示由原子基元主导的装饰倾向。研究发现即使相同取向差下晶界面倾角的改变也会影响晶界成分与原子排列。
summary_zh: 用电荷密度成像与原子探针层析揭示Fe中B、C轻间隙溶质在晶界的偏析由原子基元主导，晶界面倾角改变即影响晶界成分与原子排列，进而影响力学性能。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: Spin Glass Behavior in Amorphous Cr2Ge2Te6 Phase‐Change Alloy
title_zh: 非晶Cr2Ge2Te6相变合金中的自旋玻璃行为
abstract_en: Abstract The layered crystal structure of Cr2Ge2Te6 shows ferromagnetic ordering at the two‐dimensional limit, which holds promise for spintronic applications. However, external voltage pulses can trigger amorphization of the material in nanoscale electronic devices, and it is unclear whether the loss of structural ordering leads to a change in magnetic properties. Here, it is demonstrated that Cr2Ge2Te6 preserves the spin‐polarized nature in the amorphous phase, but undergoes a magnetic transition to a spin glass state below 20 K. Quantum‐mechanical computations reveal the microscopic origin of this transition in spin configuration: it is due to strong distortions of the CrTeCr bonds, connecting chromium‐centered octahedra, and to the overall increase in disorder upon amorphization. The tunable magnetic properties of Cr2Ge2Te6 can be exploited for multifunctional, magnetic phase‐change devices that switch between crystalline and amorphous states.
abstract_zh: Cr2Ge2Te6的层状晶体结构在二维极限下展现铁磁有序，对自旋电子学应用有前景。然而外部电压脉冲可在纳米电子器件中触发该材料的非晶化，而结构有序的丧失是否导致磁性能改变尚不清楚。本文证明Cr2Ge2Te6在非晶相中保持自旋极化性质，但在20 K以下经历向自旋玻璃态的磁转变。量子力学计算揭示这一自旋组态转变的微观起源在于连接铬中心八面体的Cr-Te-Cr键的强烈畸变及非晶化时整体无序度的增加。可调磁性能可用于多功能磁性相变应用。
summary_zh: （非合金力学/磁性）证明非晶Cr2Ge2Te6保持自旋极化但在20 K以下转变为自旋玻璃态，源于Cr-Te-Cr键强烈畸变与非晶化无序增加。

title_en: Elucidating the role of a unique step-like interfacial structure of η 4 precipitates in Al-Zn-Mg alloy
title_zh: 阐明Al-Zn-Mg合金中η4析出相独特台阶状界面结构的作用
abstract_en: Al-Zn-Mg alloys are widely used in the transportation industry owing to their high strength-to-weight ratio. In these alloys, the main strengthening mechanism is precipitation hardening that occurs because of the formation of nano-sized precipitates. Herein, an interfacial structure of η 4 precipitates, one of the main precipitates in these alloys, is revealed using aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy and first-principles calculations. These precipitates exhibit a pseudo-periodic steps and bridges. The results of this study demonstrate that the peculiar interface structure of η 4 /Al relieves the strain energy of η 4 precipitates thus stabilizing them. The atomistic role of this interfacial structure in the nucleation and growth of the precipitates is elucidated. This study paves the way for tailoring the mechanical properties of alloys by controlling their precipitation kinetics.
abstract_zh: Al-Zn-Mg合金因其高比强度广泛用于交通运输业。这些合金中主要强化机制是纳米级析出相形成引起的析出硬化。本文用球差校正扫描透射电镜与第一性原理计算揭示了η4析出相（这些合金主要析出相之一）的界面结构，其呈现伪周期台阶与桥接。结果表明η4/Al的特殊界面结构缓解了η4析出相的应变能从而稳定它们，并阐明了该界面结构在析出相形核与长大中的原子级作用，为通过控制析出相定制合金力学性能铺平道路。
summary_zh: 用球差校正STEM与第一性原理揭示Al-Zn-Mg合金η4析出相的伪周期台阶-桥接界面结构可缓解应变能而稳定析出相，为通过调控析出相调节力学性能铺路。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: In Situ Exfoliation Method of Large‐Area 2D Materials
title_zh: 大面积二维材料的原位剥离方法
abstract_en: 2D materials provide a rich platform to study novel physical phenomena arising from quantum confinement of charge carriers. Many of these phenomena are discovered by surface sensitive techniques, such as photoemission spectroscopy, that work in ultra-high vacuum (UHV). Success in experimental studies of 2D materials, however, inherently relies on producing adsorbate-free, large-area, high-quality samples. The method that yields 2D materials of highest quality is mechanical exfoliation from bulk-grown samples. However, as this technique is traditionally performed in a dedicated environment, the transfer of samples into vacuum requires surface cleaning that might diminish the quality of the samples. In this article, a simple method for in situ exfoliation directly in UHV is reported, which yields large-area, single-layered films. Multiple metallic and semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenides are exfoliated in situ onto Au, Ag, and Ge. The exfoliated flakes are found to be of sub-millimeter size with excellent crystallinity and purity, as supported by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, and low-energy electron diffraction. The approach is well-suited for air-sensitive 2D materials, enabling the study of a new suite of electronic properties. In addition, the exfoliation of surface alloys and the possibility of controlling the substrate-2D material twist angle is demonstrated.
abstract_zh: 二维材料为研究电荷载流子量子限域引起的新奇物理现象提供了丰富平台。许多现象由在超高真空（UHV）下工作的表面敏感技术（如光电子能谱）发现。然而二维材料实验研究的成功本质上依赖于制备无吸附、大面积、高质量样品。产生最高质量二维材料的方法是从块体生长样品中机械剥离，但该技术传统上在专门环境中进行，将样品转移至真空需要表面清洁，可能降低样品质量。本文报道一种在UHV中直接原位剥离的简易方法，可产生大面积单层膜。
summary_zh: （非合金力学/二维材料）报道超高真空中原位剥离大面积单层2D材料的简易方法，避免样品转移中的表面污染。

title_en: Ultra-strong tungsten refractory high-entropy alloy via stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations
title_zh: 通过逐步可控共格纳米析出实现超强钨基难熔高熵合金
abstract_en: High-performance refractory alloys with ultrahigh strength and ductility are in demand for a wide range of critical applications, such as plasma-facing components. However, it remains challenging to increase the strength of these alloys without seriously compromising their tensile ductility. Here, we put forward a strategy to "defeat" this trade-off in tungsten refractory high-entropy alloys by stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations (SCCPs). The coherent interfaces of SCCPs facilitate the dislocation transmission and relieve the stress concentrations that can lead to premature crack initiation. As a consequence, our alloy displays an ultrahigh strength of 2.15 GPa with a tensile ductility of 15% at ambient temperature, with a high yield strength of 1.05 GPa at 800 °C. The SCCPs design concept may afford a means to develop a wide range of ultrahigh-strength metallic materials by providing a pathway for alloy design.
abstract_zh: 具超高强度与塑性的高性能难熔合金在等离子体面向部件等众多关键应用中有需求，然而在不严重损害拉伸塑性的情况下提升这些合金的强度仍具挑战。本文提出通过逐步可控共格纳米析出（SCCP）在钨基难熔高熵合金中"击败"这一倒置的策略：SCCP的共格界面促进位错传递、缓解可能导致过早裂纹萌生的应力集中。结果表明该合金在室温下展现2.15 GPa的超高强度与15%拉伸塑性，800°C下屈服强度达1.05 GPa。SCCP设计理念可为开发多种超高强度金属材料提供途径。
summary_zh: 提出逐步可控共格纳米析出策略在钨基难熔高熵合金中"击败"强塑性倒置，共格界面促进位错传递、缓解应力集中，实现2.15 GPa超高强度与15%塑性、800°C下1.05 GPa屈服强度。

title_en: Deformation and failure of the CrCoNi medium-entropy alloy subjected to extreme shock loading
abstract_en: The extraordinary work hardening ability and fracture toughness of the face-centered cubic (fcc) high-entropy alloys render them ideal candidates for many structural applications. Here, the deformation and failure mechanisms of an equiatomic CrCoNi medium-entropyalloy (MEA) were investigated by powerful laser-driven shock experiments. Multiscale characterization demonstrates that profuse planar defects including stacking faults, nanotwins, and hexagonal nanolamella were generated during shock compression, forming a three-dimensional network. During shock release, the MEA fractured by strong tensile deformation and numerous voids was observed in the vicinity of the fracture plane. High defect populations, nanorecrystallization, and amorphization were found adjacent to these areas of localized deformation. Molecular dynamics simulations corroborate the experimental results and suggest that deformation-induced defects formed before void nucleation govern the geometry of void growth and delay their coalescence. Our results indicate that the CrCoNi-based alloys are impact resistant, damage tolerant, and potentially suitable in applications under extreme conditions.
title_zh: 极端冲击加载下 CrCoNi 中熵合金的变形与失效
abstract_zh: 面心立方高熵合金优异的加工硬化能力与断裂韧性使其成为众多结构应用的理想候选材料。本文用强激光驱动冲击实验研究了等原子比 CrCoNi 中熵合金(MEA)的变形与失效机制。多尺度表征表明，冲击压缩过程中产生了大量平面缺陷，包括层错、纳米孪晶和六方纳米片层，形成三维网络。冲击卸载时，该 MEA 因强烈拉伸变形而断裂，断裂面附近观察到大量孔洞，其邻近局部变形区还出现高密度缺陷、纳米再结晶与非晶化。分子动力学模拟印证了实验结果，表明孔洞形核前形成的变形诱导缺陷主导了孔洞长大的几何形态并延缓其合并。结果表明 CrCoNi 基合金抗冲击、损伤容限高，有望用于极端条件下的应用。
summary_zh: 用激光驱动冲击实验结合分子动力学证明，等原子比 CrCoNi 中熵合金在冲击压缩下形成由层错、纳米孪晶与六方纳米片层构成的三维缺陷网络，且孔洞形核前的变形诱导缺陷主导孔洞长大几何并延缓合并，从而赋予其优异的抗冲击与损伤容限。

title_en: Theory-guided design of high-entropy alloys with enhanced strength-ductility synergy
abstract_en: Metallic alloys have played essential roles in human civilization due to their balanced strength and ductility. Metastable phases and twins have been introduced to overcome the strength-ductility tradeoff in face-centered cubic (FCC) high-entropy alloys (HEAs). However, there is still a lack of quantifiable mechanisms to predict good combinations of the two mechanical properties. Here we propose a possible mechanism based on the parameter κ, the ratio of short-ranged interactions between closed-pack planes. It promotes the formation of various nanoscale stacking sequences and enhances the work-hardening ability of the alloys. Guided by the theory, we successfully designed HEAs with enhanced strength and ductility compared with other extensively studied CoCrNi-based systems. Our results not only offer a physical picture of the strengthening effects but can also be used as a practical design principle to enhance the strength-ductility synergy in HEAs.
title_zh: 理论指导设计强度-塑性协同增强的高熵合金
abstract_zh: 金属合金因兼具强度与塑性在人类文明中发挥了重要作用。人们已引入亚稳相和孪晶来克服面心立方(FCC)高熵合金(HEA)的强度-塑性倒置，但仍缺乏可定量预测两种力学性能良好组合的机制。本文提出一种基于参数 κ（密排面间短程相互作用之比）的可能机制，它促进多种纳米尺度层错序列的形成并增强合金的加工硬化能力。在该理论指导下，我们成功设计出相比广泛研究的 CoCrNi 基体系强度与塑性均增强的高熵合金。该结果既给出了强化效应的物理图像，也可作为提升高熵合金强度-塑性协同的实用设计原则。
summary_zh: 提出以密排面间短程相互作用之比参数 κ 定量预测强度-塑性组合，κ 促进纳米尺度层错序列形成并提升加工硬化，据此设计出优于 CoCrNi 基体系的高强高塑高熵合金。

title_en: Composite Nanocoatings of Biomedical Magnesium Alloy Implants: Advantages, Mechanisms, and Design Strategies
abstract_en: The rapid degradation of magnesium (Mg) alloy implants erodes mechanical performance and interfacial bioactivity, thereby limiting their clinical utility. Surface modification is among the solutions to improve corrosion resistance and bioefficacy of Mg alloys. Novel composite coatings that incorporate nanostructures create new opportunities for their expanded use. Particle size dominance and impermeability may increase corrosion resistance and thereby prolong implant service time. Nanoparticles with specific biological effects may be released into the peri-implant microenvironment during the degradation of coatings to promote healing. Composite nanocoatings provide nanoscale surfaces to promote cell adhesion and proliferation. Nanoparticles may activate cellular signaling pathways, while those with porous or core-shell structures may carry antibacterial or immunomodulatory drugs. Composite nanocoatings may promote vascular reendothelialization and osteogenesis, attenuate inflammation, and inhibit bacterial growth, thus increasing their applicability in complex clinical microenvironments such as those of atherosclerosis and open fractures. This review combines the physicochemical properties and biological efficiency of Mg-based alloy biomedical implants to summarize the advantages of composite nanocoatings, analyzes their mechanisms of action, and proposes design and construction strategies, with the purpose of providing a reference for promoting the clinical application of Mg alloy implants and to further the design of nanocoatings.
title_zh: 生物医用镁合金植入体的复合纳米涂层：优势、机制与设计策略
abstract_zh: 镁(Mg)合金植入体的快速降解会侵蚀其力学性能和界面生物活性，从而限制临床应用。表面改性是提高镁合金耐蚀性与生物功效的方案之一，融入纳米结构的新型复合涂层为其拓展应用创造了新机会。颗粒尺寸优势与不渗透性可提高耐蚀性、延长植入体使用寿命；涂层降解过程中释放的具特定生物效应的纳米颗粒可进入植入体周围微环境促进愈合。复合纳米涂层提供纳米尺度表面以促进细胞黏附与增殖，纳米颗粒可激活细胞信号通路，具多孔或核壳结构者还可携载抗菌或免疫调节药物。复合纳米涂层可促进血管再内皮化与成骨、抑制炎症、抑制细菌生长，从而在动脉粥样硬化、开放性骨折等复杂临床微环境中提高适用性。本综述结合其理化性质进行论述。
summary_zh: 综述复合纳米涂层如何通过颗粒尺寸屏蔽与生物活性纳米颗粒释放，提升生物医用镁合金植入体的耐蚀性与界面生物活性，促进细胞黏附、成骨与血管化并抑菌（综述，非力学）。

title_en: A 3D printable alloy designed for extreme environments
abstract_en: Abstract Multiprincipal-element alloys are an enabling class of materials owing to their impressive mechanical and oxidation-resistant properties, especially in extreme environments 1,2 . Here we develop a new oxide-dispersion-strengthened NiCoCr-based alloy using a model-driven alloy design approach and laser-based additive manufacturing. This oxide-dispersion-strengthened alloy, called GRX-810, uses laser powder bed fusion to disperse nanoscale Y 2 O 3 particles throughout the microstructure without the use of resource-intensive processing steps such as mechanical or in situ alloying 3,4 . We show the successful incorporation and dispersion of nanoscale oxides throughout the GRX-810 build volume via high-resolution characterization of its microstructure. The mechanical results of GRX-810 show a twofold improvement in strength, over 1,000-fold better creep performance and twofold improvement in oxidation resistance compared with the traditional polycrystalline wrought Ni-based alloys used extensively in additive manufacturing at 1,093 °C 5,6 . The success of this alloy highlights how model-driven alloy designs can provide superior compositions using far fewer resources compared with the ‘trial-and-error’ methods of the past. These results showcase how future alloy development that leverages dispersion strengthening combined with additive manufacturing processing can accelerate the discovery of revolutionary materials.
title_zh: 一种面向极端环境设计的可 3D 打印合金
abstract_zh: 多主元合金因在极端环境下具优异的力学与抗氧化性能而成为一类使能材料。本文采用模型驱动的合金设计方法与激光增材制造，开发出一种新型氧化物弥散强化 NiCoCr 基合金 GRX-810，利用激光粉末床熔融在组织中弥散分布纳米级 Y₂O₃ 颗粒，无需机械合金化或原位合金化等资源密集工序。通过高分辨表征证实了纳米氧化物在整个 GRX-810 打印体积内的成功引入与弥散。GRX-810 的力学结果显示，在 1093°C 下相比增材制造中广泛使用的传统多晶锻造镍基合金，其强度翻倍、蠕变性能提升千倍以上、抗氧化性翻倍。该合金的成功凸显了模型驱动合金设计能以远更少的资源提供更优成分。
summary_zh: 采用模型驱动设计与激光粉末床熔融开发出氧化物弥散强化的 NiCoCr 基合金 GRX-810，在 1093°C 下相比传统锻造镍基合金强度翻倍、蠕变性能提升千倍以上、抗氧化性翻倍。

title_en: Trifunctional nanoprecipitates ductilize and toughen a strong laminated metastable titanium alloy
abstract_en: Metastability-engineering, e.g., transformation-induced plasticity (TRIP), can enhance the ductility of alloys, however it often comes at the expense of relatively low yield strength. Here, using a metastable Ti-1Al-8.5Mo-2.8Cr-2.7Zr (wt.%) alloy as a model material, we fabricate a heterogeneous laminated structure decorated by multiple-morphological α-nanoprecipitates. The hard α nanoprecipitate in our alloy acts not only as a strengthener to the material, but also as a local stress raiser to activate TRIP in the soft matrix for great uniform elongation and as a promoter to trigger interfacial delamination toughening for superior fracture resistance. By elaborately manipulating the activation sequence of lamellar-thickness-dependent deformation mechanisms in Ti-1Al-8.5Mo-2.8Cr-2.7Zr alloys, the yield strength of the present submicron-laminated alloy is twice that of equiaxed-coarse grained alloys with the same composition, yet without sacrificing the large uniform elongation. The desired mechanical properties enabled by this strategy combining the laminated metastable structure and trifunctional nanoprecipitates provide new insights into designing ultra-strong and ductile materials with great toughness.
title_zh: 三功能纳米析出相使强层状亚稳钛合金增塑增韧
abstract_zh: 亚稳性工程（如相变诱导塑性 TRIP）可增强合金塑性，但往往以相对较低的屈服强度为代价。本文以亚稳 Ti-1Al-8.5Mo-2.8Cr-2.7Zr(wt.%)合金为模型材料，制备了由多形貌 α 纳米析出相修饰的异质层状结构。合金中硬质 α 纳米析出相不仅作为材料强化相，还作为局部应力集中源在软基体中激活 TRIP 以获得高均匀延伸率，并作为触发界面分层增韧的促进者以获得优异断裂抗力。通过精细调控 Ti-1Al-8.5Mo-2.8Cr-2.7Zr 合金中依赖片层厚度的变形机制激活次序，该亚微米层状合金的屈服强度达到同成分等轴粗晶合金的两倍，同时不牺牲大的均匀延伸率。该策略结合层状亚稳结构与三功能纳米析出相所实现的优异力学性能，为设计超强高塑材料提供了新见解。
summary_zh: 在亚稳 Ti-1Al-8.5Mo-2.8Cr-2.7Zr 合金中构建异质层状结构与多形貌 α 纳米析出相，使析出相兼具强化、触发 TRIP、促进界面分层增韧三重功能，屈服强度较等轴粗晶翻倍且不损失均匀延伸率。

title_en: Efficient Coarse‐Grained Superplasticity of a Gigapascal Lightweight Refractory Medium Entropy Alloy
abstract_en: Abstract Superplastic metals that exhibit exceptional ductility (>300%) are appealing for use in high‐quality engineering components with complex shapes. However, the wide application of most superplastic alloys has been constrained due to their poor strength, the relatively long superplastic deformation period, and the complex and high‐cost grain refinement processes. Here these issues are addressed by the coarse‐grained superplasticity of high‐strength lightweight medium entropy alloy (Ti43.3V28Zr14Nb14Mo0.7, at.%) with a microstructure of ultrafine particles embedded in the body‐centered‐cubic matrix. The results demonstrate that the alloy reached a high coarse‐grained superplasticity greater than ≈440% at a high strain rate of 10−2 s−1 at 1173 K and with a gigapascal residual strength. A consecutively triggered deformation mechanism that sequences of dislocation slip, dynamic recrystallization, and grain boundary sliding in such alloy differs from conventional grain‐boundary sliding in fine‐grained materials. The present results open a pathway for highly efficient superplastic forming, broaden superplastic materials to the high‐strength field, and guide the development of new alloys.
title_zh: 一种吉帕级轻质难熔中熵合金的高效粗晶超塑性
abstract_zh: 具超凡塑性(>300%)的超塑性金属对制造形状复杂的高质量工程构件颇具吸引力。然而大多数超塑性合金因强度差、超塑性变形周期长以及晶粒细化工艺复杂且成本高，应用受限。本文通过高强轻质中熵合金(Ti43.3V28Zr14Nb14Mo0.7, at.%)的粗晶超塑性解决上述问题，其组织为嵌入体心立方基体的超细颗粒。结果表明，该合金在 1173K、高应变速率 10⁻² s⁻¹ 下实现了大于约 440% 的高粗晶超塑性，并保持吉帕级残余强度。该合金中位错滑移、动态再结晶与晶界滑动依次连续触发的变形机制，区别于细晶材料中传统的晶界滑动。该结果开辟了高效超塑性成形途径，将超塑性材料拓展到高强度领域，并为新型合金研发提供指导。
summary_zh: 在轻质难熔中熵合金 Ti43.3V28Zr14Nb14Mo0.7 中借助嵌入 BCC 基体的超细颗粒，于 1173K、10⁻² s⁻¹ 高应变速率下实现超 440% 的粗晶超塑性且残余强度达吉帕级，其位错滑移-动态再结晶-晶界滑动的连续变形机制区别于传统细晶超塑性。

title_en: Manipulating the ordered oxygen complexes to achieve high strength and ductility in medium-entropy alloys
abstract_en: Oxygen solute strengthening is an effective strategy to harden alloys, yet, it often deteriorates the ductility. Ordered oxygen complexes (OOCs), a state between random interstitials and oxides, can simultaneously enhance strength and ductility in high-entropy alloys. However, whether this particular strengthening mechanism holds in other alloys and how these OOCs are tailored remain unclear. Herein, we demonstrate that OOCs can be obtained in bcc (body-centered-cubic) Ti-Zr-Nb medium-entropy alloys via adjusting the content of Nb and oxygen. Decreasing the phase stability enhances the degree of (Ti, Zr)-rich chemical short-range orderings, and then favors formation of OOCs after doping oxygen. Moreover, the number density of OOCs increases with oxygen contents in a given alloy, but adding excessive oxygen (>3.0 at.%) causes grain boundary segregation. Consequently, the tensile yield strength is enhanced by ~75% and ductility is substantially improved by ~164% with addition of 3.0 at.% O in the Ti-30Zr-14Nb MEA.

title_zh: 调控有序氧复合体在中熵合金中实现高强度与高塑性
abstract_zh: 氧固溶强化是强化合金的有效策略，但常使塑性恶化。有序氧复合体(OOC)是介于随机间隙原子与氧化物之间的一种状态，可在高熵合金中同时增强强度与塑性。然而这一特殊强化机制是否适用于其他合金、以及如何调控这些 OOC 仍不清楚。本文证明，通过调节 Nb 与氧含量，可在体心立方 Ti-Zr-Nb 中熵合金中获得 OOC。降低相稳定性可增强(Ti,Zr)富集的化学短程有序程度，进而在掺氧后促进 OOC 形成。此外，OOC 数密度随给定合金中氧含量增加而增大，但加入过量氧(>3.0 at.%)会导致晶界偏聚。因此，在 Ti-30Zr-14Nb 中熵合金中加入 3.0 at.% O 使拉伸屈服强度提升约 75%、塑性大幅提升约 164%。
summary_zh: 在体心立方 Ti-Zr-Nb 中熵合金中通过调节 Nb 与氧含量获得介于随机间隙与氧化物之间的有序氧复合体，加入 3.0 at.% O 使屈服强度提升约 75%、塑性提升约 164%，实现强度-塑性同步增强。

title_en: Grain refinement in titanium prevents low temperature oxygen embrittlement
abstract_en: Interstitial oxygen embrittles titanium, particularly at cryogenic temperatures, which necessitates a stringent control of oxygen content in fabricating titanium and its alloys. Here, we propose a structural strategy, via grain refinement, to alleviate this problem. Compared to a coarse-grained counterpart that is extremely brittle at 77 K, the uniform elongation of an ultrafine-grained (UFG) microstructure (grain size ~ 2.0 µm) in Ti-0.3wt.%O is successfully increased by an order of magnitude, maintaining an ultrahigh yield strength inherent to the UFG microstructure. This unique strength-ductility synergy in UFG Ti-0.3wt.%O is achieved via the combined effects of diluted grain boundary segregation of oxygen that helps to improve the grain boundary cohesive energy and enhanced dislocation activities that contribute to the excellent strain hardening ability. The present strategy will not only boost the potential applications of high strength Ti-O alloys at low temperatures, but can also be applied to other alloy systems, where interstitial solution hardening results into an undesirable loss of ductility.
title_zh: 晶粒细化防止钛的低温氧脆
abstract_zh: 间隙氧会使钛变脆，尤其在低温下，这就要求在制备钛及其合金时严格控制氧含量。本文提出一种通过晶粒细化的结构策略来缓解该问题。相比在 77K 下极脆的粗晶对照材料，Ti-0.3wt.%O 超细晶(UFG)组织（晶粒尺寸约 2.0 μm）的均匀延伸率成功提高了一个数量级，同时保持了 UFG 组织固有的超高屈服强度。UFG Ti-0.3wt.%O 中这种独特的强度-塑性协同，是通过稀释的氧晶界偏聚（有助提高晶界结合能）与增强的位错活动（贡献优异应变硬化能力）的协同效应实现的。该策略不仅能推动高强 Ti-O 合金在低温下的潜在应用，也可推广到其他因间隙固溶硬化导致塑性下降的合金体系。
summary_zh: 通过将 Ti-0.3wt.%O 晶粒细化至约 2.0 μm 的超细晶组织，使其在 77K 下均匀延伸率提升一个数量级且保持超高屈服强度，机制在于稀释的氧晶界偏聚提高晶界结合能并增强位错应变硬化。

title_en: Doubled strength and ductility via maraging effect and dynamic precipitate transformation in ultrastrong medium-entropy alloy
abstract_en: Demands for ultrahigh strength in structural materials have been steadily increasing in response to environmental issues. Maraging alloys offer a high tensile strength and fracture toughness through a reduction of lattice defects and formation of intermetallic precipitates. The semi-coherent precipitates are crucial for exhibiting ultrahigh strength; however, they still result in limited work hardening and uniform ductility. Here, we demonstrate a strategy involving deformable semi-coherent precipitates and their dynamic phase transformation based on a narrow stability gap between two kinds of ordered phases. In a model medium-entropy alloy, the matrix precipitate acts as a dislocation barrier and also dislocation glide media; the grain-boundary precipitate further contributes to a significant work-hardening via dynamic precipitate transformation into the type of matrix precipitate. This combination results in a twofold enhancement of strength and uniform ductility, thus suggesting a promising alloy design concept for enhanced mechanical properties in developing various ultrastrong metallic materials.
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
Pohang University of Science and Technology
title_zh: 通过马氏体时效效应与动态析出相转变在超强中熵合金中实现强度与塑性翻倍
abstract_zh: 为应对环境问题，对结构材料超高强度的需求持续增长。马氏体时效合金通过减少晶格缺陷和形成金属间化合物析出相提供高抗拉强度与断裂韧性。半共格析出相对表现超高强度至关重要，但仍导致有限的加工硬化与均匀塑性。本文展示了一种基于两种有序相之间窄稳定性间隙、利用可变形半共格析出相及其动态相变的策略。在一种模型中熵合金中，基体析出相既作为位错障碍又作为位错滑移媒介；晶界析出相则通过动态转变为基体析出相类型进一步贡献显著的加工硬化。这一组合实现了强度与均匀塑性的双倍提升，为开发各类超强金属材料提供了有前景的合金设计理念。
summary_zh: 利用可变形半共格析出相及其基于两种有序相窄稳定性间隙的动态相变，使基体析出相兼作位错障碍与滑移媒介、晶界析出相通过动态转变显著提升加工硬化，实现中熵合金强度与均匀塑性同步翻倍。
subtopic: 微观组织 / 相–力学关联

title_en: Vascular smooth muscle-inspired architecture enables soft yet tough self-healing materials for durable capacitive strain-sensor
abstract_en: Abstract Catastrophically mechanical failure of soft self-healing materials is unavoidable due to their inherently poor resistance to crack propagation. Here, with a model system, i.e., soft self-healing polyurea, we present a biomimetic strategy of surpassing trade-off between soft self-healing and high fracture toughness, enabling the conversion of soft and weak into soft yet tough self-healing material. Such an achievement is inspired by vascular smooth muscles, where core-shell structured Galinstan micro-droplets are introduced through molecularly interfacial metal-coordinated assembly, resulting in an increased crack-resistant strain and fracture toughness of 12.2 and 34.9 times without sacrificing softness. The obtained fracture toughness is up to 111.16 ± 8.76 kJ/m2, even higher than that of Al and Zn alloys. Moreover, the resultant composite delivers fast self-healing kinetics (1 min) upon local near-infrared irradiation, and possesses ultra-high dielectric constants (~14.57), thus being able to be fabricated into sensitive and self-healing capacitive strain-sensors tolerant towards cracks potentially evolved in service.
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology
title_zh: 受血管平滑肌结构启发的软而韧自愈合材料用于耐久电容式应变传感器
abstract_zh: 软自愈合材料因固有的抗裂纹扩展能力差而不可避免地发生灾难性力学失效。本文以软自愈合聚脲为模型体系，提出一种仿生策略以突破软自愈合与高断裂韧性之间的折衷，使软而弱转变为软而韧的自愈合材料。这一成就受血管平滑肌启发，通过分子界面金属配位组装引入核壳结构的镓铟锡液态金属微滴，使抗裂应变与断裂韧性分别提高 12.2 与 34.9 倍而不牺牲柔软性。所得断裂韧性高达 111.16±8.76 kJ/m²，甚至高于铝、锌合金。此外，该复合材料在局部近红外照射下具快速自愈合动力学(1 分钟)，并具超高介电常数(~14.57)，可制成对服役中裂纹容限的灵敏自愈合电容式应变传感器。
summary_zh: 受血管平滑肌启发，在软自愈合聚脲中引入核壳结构镓铟锡液态金属微滴，将抗裂应变与断裂韧性分别提升 12.2 与 34.9 倍（断裂韧性达 111 kJ/m²，高于铝锌合金）且不损失柔软性，并实现 1 分钟快速自愈合（非合金力学工作）。

title_en: Design of N‐Type Textured Bi2Te3 with Robust Mechanical Properties for Thermoelectric Micro‐Refrigeration Application
abstract_en: Abstract Thermoelectric refrigeration is one of the mature techniques used for cooling applications, with the great advantage of miniaturization over traditional compression refrigeration. Due to the anisotropic thermoelectric properties of n‐type bismuth telluride (Bi2Te3) alloys, these two common methods, including the liquid phase hot deformation (LPHD) and traditional hot forging (HF) methods, are of considerable importance for texture engineering to enhance performance. However, their effects on thermoelectric and mechanical properties are still controversial and not clear yet. Moreover, there has been little documentation of mechanical properties related to micro‐refrigeration applications. In this work, the above‐mentioned methods are separately employed to control the macroscopic grain orientation for bulk n‐type Bi2Te3 samples. The HF method enabled the stabilization of both composition and carrier concentration, therefore yielding a higher quality factor to compare with that of LPHD samples, supported by DFT calculations. In addition to superior thermoelectric performance, the HF sample also exhibited robust mechanical properties due to the presence of nano‐scale distortion and dense dislocation, which is the prerequisite for realizing ultra‐precision machining. This work helps to pave the way for the utilization of n‐type Bi2Te3 for commercial micro‐refrigeration applications.
title_zh: 设计具稳健力学性能的 N 型织构 Bi₂Te₃ 用于热电微制冷应用
abstract_zh: 热电制冷是用于制冷应用的成熟技术之一，相比传统压缩制冷具小型化的巨大优势。由于 N 型碲化铋(Bi₂Te₃)合金的各向异性热电性能，液相热变形(LPHD)与传统热锻(HF)这两种常用方法对通过织构工程提升性能颇为重要。然而它们对热电与力学性能的影响仍有争议且不清楚，且鲜有关于微制冷应用相关力学性能的记录。本文分别采用上述方法控制块体 N 型 Bi₂Te₃ 样品的宏观晶粒取向。HF 方法稳定了成分与载流子浓度，因而获得比 LPHD 样品更高的品质因子（DFT 计算支持）。除优异热电性能外，HF 样品还因存在纳米尺度畸变而表现出稳健的力学性能。
summary_zh: 对比液相热变形与传统热锻两种织构工程方法制备 N 型 Bi₂Te₃，发现热锻法稳定了成分与载流子浓度、获得更高品质因子的热电性能，同时因纳米尺度畸变表现出稳健力学性能（热电功能材料）。

title_en: High‐Throughput Metal 3D Printing Pen Enabled by a Continuous Molten Droplet Transfer
abstract_en: In metal additive manufacturing (AM), arc plasma is attracting attention as an alternative heat source to expensive lasers to enable the use of various metal wire materials with a high deposition efficiency. However, the stepwise material deposition and resulting limited number of degrees of freedom limit their potential for high-throughput and large-scale production for industrial applications. Herein, a high-throughput metal 3D printing pen (M3DPen) strategy is proposed based on an arc plasma heat source by harnessing the surface tension of the molten metal for enabling continuous material deposition without a downward flow by gravity. The proposed approach differs from conventional arc-based metal AM in that it controls the solidification and cooling time between interlayers of a point-by-point deposition path, thereby allowing for continuous metal 3D printing of freestanding and overhanging structures at once. The resulting mechanical properties and unique microstructures by continuous metal deposition that occur due to the difference in the thermal conditions of the molten metal under cooling are also investigated. This technology can be applied to a wide range of alloy systems and industrial manufacturing, thereby providing new possibilities for metal 3D printing.
title_zh: 由连续熔融液滴转移实现的高通量金属 3D 打印笔
abstract_zh: 在金属增材制造(AM)中，电弧等离子体作为昂贵激光的替代热源受到关注，可高沉积效率地使用多种金属丝材。然而逐步的材料沉积及由此带来的有限自由度，限制了其在工业应用中高通量、大规模生产的潜力。本文提出一种基于电弧等离子体热源的高通量金属 3D 打印笔(M3DPen)策略，利用熔融金属的表面张力实现连续材料沉积而不因重力向下流动。该方法不同于传统电弧金属 AM，它控制点对点沉积路径层间的凝固与冷却时间，从而一次性连续 3D 打印自支撑与悬垂结构。研究还考察了连续金属沉积因熔融金属冷却热条件差异而产生的力学性能与独特微观组织。该技术可应用于广泛的合金体系。
summary_zh: 提出基于电弧等离子体热源、利用熔融金属表面张力实现连续沉积的高通量金属 3D 打印笔(M3DPen)，通过控制点对点沉积路径的层间凝固冷却时间实现自支撑与悬垂结构的连续金属打印，并考察其独特组织与力学性能。
subtopic: 增材制造 / 加工–力学

title_en: Phonon behavior in a random solid solution: a lattice dynamics study on the high-entropy alloy FeCoCrMnNi
abstract_en: Abstract High-Entropy Alloys (HEAs) are a new family of crystalline random alloys with four or more elements in a simple unit cell, at the forefront of materials research for their exceptional mechanical properties. Their strong chemical disorder leads to mass and force-constant fluctuations which are expected to strongly reduce phonon lifetime, responsible for thermal transport, similarly to glasses. Still, the long range order would associate HEAs to crystals with a complex disordered unit cell. These two families of materials, however, exhibit very different phonon dynamics, still leading to similar thermal properties. The question arises on the positioning of HEAs in this context. Here we present an exhaustive experimental investigation of the lattice dynamics in a HEA, Fe 20 Co 20 Cr 20 Mn 20 Ni 20 , using inelastic neutron and X-ray scattering. We demonstrate that HEAs present unique phonon dynamics at the frontier between fully disordered and ordered materials, characterized by long-propagating acoustic phonons in the whole Brillouin zone.

title_zh: 无规固溶体中的声子行为：高熵合金 FeCoCrMnNi 的晶格动力学研究
abstract_zh: 高熵合金(HEA)是一类在简单晶胞中含四种或更多元素的新型晶态无规合金，因其优异力学性能处于材料研究前沿。其强烈的化学无序导致质量与力常数涨落，预期会像玻璃那样强烈缩短负责热输运的声子寿命。然而长程有序又会将高熵合金归为具复杂无序晶胞的晶体。这两类材料的声子动力学差异很大，却导致相似的热性能，因而产生了高熵合金在此背景下定位的问题。本文用非弹性中子与 X 射线散射对高熵合金 Fe₂₀Co₂₀Cr₂₀Mn₂₀Ni₂₀ 的晶格动力学进行了详尽实验研究，证明高熵合金呈现介于完全无序与有序材料之间的独特声子动力学，在整个布里渊区具长程传播的声学声子。
summary_zh: 用非弹性中子与 X 射线散射研究 FeCoCrMnNi 高熵合金的晶格动力学，证实其呈现介于完全无序与有序材料之间的独特声子动力学、在整个布里渊区存在长程传播的声学声子（声子/热输运研究，非力学）。

title_en: Exceptional fracture toughness of CrCoNi-based medium- and high-entropy alloys at 20 kelvin
abstract_en: CrCoNi-based medium- and high-entropy alloys display outstanding damage tolerance, especially at cryogenic temperatures. In this study, we examined the fracture toughness values of the equiatomic CrCoNi and CrMnFeCoNi alloys at 20 kelvin (K). We found exceptionally high crack-initiation fracture toughnesses of 262 and 459 megapascal-meters ½ (MPa·m ½ ) for CrMnFeCoNi and CrCoNi, respectively; CrCoNi displayed a crack-growth toughness exceeding 540 MPa·m ½ after 2.25 millimeters of stable cracking. Crack-tip deformation structures at 20 K are quite distinct from those at higher temperatures. They involve nucleation and restricted growth of stacking faults, fine nanotwins, and transformed epsilon martensite, with coherent interfaces that can promote both arrest and transmission of dislocations to generate strength and ductility. We believe that these alloys develop fracture resistance through a progressive synergy of deformation mechanisms, dislocation glide, stacking-fault formation, nanotwinning, and phase transformation, which act in concert to prolong strain hardening that simultaneously elevates strength and ductility, leading to exceptional toughness.
title_zh: CrCoNi 基中熵与高熵合金在 20 开尔文下的超凡断裂韧性
abstract_zh: CrCoNi 基中熵与高熵合金展现出卓越的损伤容限，尤其在低温下。本研究考察了等原子比 CrCoNi 与 CrMnFeCoNi 合金在 20 开尔文(K)下的断裂韧性值。我们发现 CrMnFeCoNi 与 CrCoNi 的裂纹起始断裂韧性分别高达 262 与 459 MPa·m½；CrCoNi 在稳定扩展 2.25 毫米后裂纹扩展韧性超过 540 MPa·m½。20K 下的裂尖变形结构与较高温度下迥异，涉及层错、细纳米孪晶及转变的 ε 马氏体的形核与受限长大，其共格界面可促进位错的塞积与传递以产生强度和塑性。我们认为这些合金通过位错滑移、层错形成、纳米孪生与相变等变形机制的渐进协同发展出断裂抗力，共同延长应变硬化并同步提升强度与塑性，从而带来超凡韧性。
summary_zh: 测得 CrMnFeCoNi 与 CrCoNi 在 20K 下裂纹起始断裂韧性分别高达 262 与 459 MPa·m½、CrCoNi 裂纹扩展韧性超 540 MPa·m½，其低温下层错、纳米孪晶与 ε 马氏体相变的协同变形延长应变硬化、同步提升强度与塑性。

title_en: Inhibiting creep in nanograined alloys with stable grain boundary networks
abstract_en: Creep, the time-dependent deformation of materials stressed below the yield strength, is responsible for a great number of component failures at high temperatures. Because grain boundaries (GBs) in materials usually facilitate diffusional processes in creep, eliminating GBs is a primary approach to resisting high-temperature creep in metals, such as in single-crystal superalloy turbo blades. We report a different strategy to inhibiting creep by use of stable GB networks. Plastic deformation triggered structural relaxation of high-density GBs in nanograined single-phased nickel-cobalt-chromium alloys, forming networks of stable GBs interlocked with abundant twin boundaries. The stable GB networks effectively inhibit diffusional creep processes at high temperatures. We obtained an unprecedented creep resistance, with creep rates of ~10 –7 per second under gigapascal stress at 700°C (~61% melting point), outperforming that of conventional superalloys.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
title_zh: 用稳定晶界网络抑制纳米晶合金的蠕变
abstract_zh: 蠕变是材料在低于屈服强度的应力下随时间发生的变形，是高温下大量构件失效的原因。由于材料中的晶界(GB)通常在蠕变中促进扩散过程，消除晶界是抵抗金属高温蠕变的主要途径，如单晶高温合金涡轮叶片。我们报道一种利用稳定晶界网络抑制蠕变的不同策略。塑性变形触发纳米晶单相镍-钴-铬合金中高密度晶界的结构弛豫，形成与大量孪晶界互锁的稳定晶界网络。稳定晶界网络有效抑制了高温下的扩散蠕变过程。我们获得了前所未有的抗蠕变性——在 700°C(约 61% 熔点)、吉帕应力下蠕变速率约为 10⁻⁷/秒，优于传统高温合金。
summary_zh: 提出以稳定晶界网络而非消除晶界来抗蠕变——塑性变形触发纳米晶 NiCoCr 合金高密度晶界弛豫、形成与大量孪晶界互锁的稳定晶界网络，在 700°C、吉帕应力下获得约 10⁻⁷/s 的空前抗蠕变性能，优于传统高温合金。

title_en: Data-driven electron-diffraction approach reveals local short-range ordering in CrCoNi with ordering effects
abstract_en: Abstract The exceptional mechanical strength of medium/high-entropy alloys has been attributed to hardening in random solid solutions. Here, we evidence non-random chemical mixing in a CrCoNi alloy, resulting from short-range ordering. A data-mining approach of electron nanodiffraction enabled the study, which is assisted by neutron scattering, atom probe tomography, and diffraction simulation using first-principles theory models. Two samples, one homogenized and one heat-treated, are observed. In both samples, results reveal two types of short-range-order inside nanoclusters that minimize the Cr–Cr nearest neighbors (L1 2 ) or segregate Cr on alternating close-packed planes (L1 1 ). The L1 1 is predominant in the homogenized sample, while the L1 2 formation is promoted by heat-treatment, with the latter being accompanied by a dramatic change in dislocation-slip behavior. These findings uncover short-range order and the resulted chemical heterogeneities behind the mechanical strength in CrCoNi, providing general opportunities for atomistic-structure study in concentrated alloys for the design of strong and ductile materials.
title_zh: 数据驱动电子衍射方法揭示 CrCoNi 中的局域短程有序及其有序化效应
abstract_zh: 中/高熵合金优异的力学强度一直归因于无规固溶体中的硬化。本文在 CrCoNi 合金中证实了由短程有序导致的非随机化学混合。一种电子纳米衍射的数据挖掘方法支撑了该研究，并辅以中子散射、原子探针层析和基于第一性原理理论模型的衍射模拟。观察了均匀化和热处理两种样品。两种样品中结果都揭示了纳米团簇内两类短程有序——使 Cr-Cr 最近邻最小化(L1₂)或使 Cr 在交替密排面上偏析(L1₁)。均匀化样品中 L1₁ 占主导，而热处理促进 L1₂ 形成，后者伴随位错滑移行为的剧烈改变。这些发现揭示了 CrCoNi 力学强度背后的短程有序及由此产生的化学不均匀性，为浓合金原子结构研究以设计强而韧的材料提供了普遍机会。
summary_zh: 结合电子纳米衍射数据挖掘、中子散射、原子探针与第一性原理模拟，在 CrCoNi 中发现两类短程有序纳米团簇(L1₂/L1₁)，热处理促进 L1₂ 形成并伴随位错滑移行为显著改变，揭示了短程有序及化学不均匀性对合金强度的作用。
subtopic: 变形机制 / 位错·孪生
