title_en: Hierarchical nano-martensite-engineered a low-cost ultra-strong and ductile titanium alloy
abstract_en: Abstract Due to the low thermal stability of crystallographic boundaries, the grain boundary engineering (GBE) manifests some limits to the fineness and types of microstructures achievable, while unique chemical boundary engineering (CBE) enables us to create a metallic material with an ultrafine hierarchically heterogeneous microstructure for enhancing the mechanical properties of materials. Here, using a low cost metastable Ti-2.8Cr-4.5Zr-5.2Al (wt.%) alloy as a model material, we create a high density of chemical boundaries (CBs) through the significant diffusion mismatch between Cr and Al alloying elements to architecture hierarchical nano-martensites with an average thickness of ~20 nm. For this metastable titanium alloy, the significantly enhanced yield strength originates from dense nano-martensitic interface strengthening, meanwhile the large ductility is attributed to the multi-stage strain hardening of hierarchical 3D α'/β lamellae assisted by equiaxed primary α (αp) nodules. The hierarchical nano-martensite engineering strategy confers our alloy a desired combination of strength and ductility, which can potentially be applied to many transformable alloys, and reveal a new target in microstructural design for ultrastrong-yet-ductile structural materials.
title_zh: 分级纳米马氏体工程构筑低成本超强高塑钛合金
abstract_zh: 由于晶体学边界热稳定性低，晶界工程(GBE)在可实现微观组织的细度与类型上存在局限，而独特的化学边界工程(CBE)使我们能够创造具超细分级异质组织的金属材料以增强其力学性能。本文以低成本亚稳 Ti-2.8Cr-4.5Zr-5.2Al(wt.%)合金为模型材料，通过 Cr 与 Al 合金元素间的显著扩散失配构建高密度化学边界(CB)，构筑平均厚度约 20 nm 的分级纳米马氏体。对该亚稳钛合金而言，显著增强的屈服强度源自致密纳米马氏体界面强化，而大塑性则归因于等轴初生 α(αp)结节辅助的分级 3D α'/β 片层的多级应变硬化。分级纳米马氏体工程策略赋予该合金强度与塑性的理想组合，可推广到许多可转变合金，并揭示了新途径。
summary_zh: 在低成本亚稳 Ti-2.8Cr-4.5Zr-5.2Al 合金中利用 Cr 与 Al 扩散失配构建高密度化学边界、构筑约 20 nm 厚的分级纳米马氏体，界面强化提供高屈服强度、分级 α'/β 片层多级应变硬化贡献大塑性，实现强度-塑性优异组合。

title_en: The influence of alloying on slip intermittency and the implications for dwell fatigue in titanium
abstract_en: Abstract Dwell fatigue, the reduction in fatigue life experienced by titanium alloys due to holds at stresses as low as 60% of yield, has been implicated in several uncontained jet engine failures. Dislocation slip has long been observed to be an intermittent, scale-bridging phenomenon, similar to that seen in earthquakes but at the nanoscale, leading to the speculation that large stress bursts might promote the initial opening of a crack. Here we observe such stress bursts at the scale of individual grains in situ, using high energy X-ray diffraction microscopy in Ti–7Al–O alloys. This shows that the detrimental effect of precipitation of ordered Ti3Al is to increase the magnitude of rare pri〈a〉 and bas〈a〉 slip bursts associated with slip localisation. By contrast, the addition of trace O interstitials is beneficial, reducing the magnitude of slip bursts and promoting a higher frequency of smaller events. This is further evidence that the formation of long paths for easy basal plane slip localisation should be avoided when engineering titanium alloys against dwell fatigue.
title_zh: 合金化对滑移间歇性的影响及其对钛合金驻留疲劳的意义
abstract_zh: 驻留疲劳，即钛合金因在低至屈服强度 60% 的应力下保载而经历的疲劳寿命降低，已被认为与多起非包容式喷气发动机失效有关。长期以来位错滑移被观察到是一种间歇性、跨尺度现象，类似地震但发生在纳米尺度，由此推测大的应力猝发可能促进裂纹的初始张开。本文用高能 X 射线衍射显微术原位观测 Ti-7Al-O 合金中单个晶粒尺度上的此类应力猝发。结果表明，有序 Ti₃Al 析出的有害作用在于增大与滑移局部化相关的稀有柱面〈a〉和基面〈a〉滑移猝发的幅度。相反，痕量 O 间隙原子的加入是有益的，可减小滑移猝发幅度并促进更高频率的较小事件。这进一步证明，在设计抗驻留疲劳的钛合金时应避免形成利于基面滑移局部化的长路径。
summary_zh: 用高能 X 射线衍射显微术原位观测 Ti-7Al-O 合金单晶粒尺度应力猝发，发现有序 Ti₃Al 析出增大稀有柱面/基面〈a〉滑移猝发幅度、加剧滑移局部化，而痕量间隙 O 减小猝发幅度、促进更频繁小事件，据此指导抗驻留疲劳钛合金设计。

title_en: Towards development of a high-strength stainless Mg alloy with Al-assisted growth of passive film
abstract_en: Abstract Magnesium alloys with high strength and excellent corrosion resistance are always sought-after in light-weighting structural components for automotive and aerospace applications. However, for most magnesium alloys that have a high specific strength, they usually have an inferior corrosion resistance and vice versa. In this work, we successfully develop a Mg-11Y-1Al (wt. %) alloy through conventional casting, solution treatment followed by extrusion. The overall properties of this alloy feature with a corrosion rate lower than 0.2 mm y −1 , high yield strength of 350 MPa and moderate tensile elongation of 8%, the combination of which shows competitive advantage over other comparative magnesium alloys in the literature. It is found that a thin and dense protective film of Y 2 O 3 /Y(OH) 3 can be fast developed with the aid of Al 2 O 3 /Al(OH) 3 deposition to isolate this alloy from further attack of corrosion medium. Meanwhile, the refined grains, weak texture and activation of non-basal slip systems co-contribute to the high strength and good ductility. Our findings are expected to inspire the design of next-generation high performance magnesium alloys.
title_zh: 借助 Al 促进钝化膜生长研制高强度不锈镁合金
abstract_zh: 兼具高强度与优异耐蚀性的镁合金一直是汽车和航空航天轻量化结构件所追求的。然而对大多数具高比强度的镁合金而言，它们通常耐蚀性较差，反之亦然。本文通过常规铸造、固溶处理及随后挤压成功研制出 Mg-11Y-1Al(wt.%)合金。该合金的综合性能表现为腐蚀速率低于 0.2 mm/年、高屈服强度 350 MPa 及中等拉伸延伸率 8%，其组合相比文献中其他对比镁合金具竞争优势。研究发现，借助 Al₂O₃/Al(OH)₃ 沉积可快速形成一层薄而致密的 Y₂O₃/Y(OH)₃ 保护膜以隔离该合金免受腐蚀介质进一步侵蚀。同时，细化晶粒、弱织构及非基面滑移系的激活共同贡献了高强度与良好塑性。研究结果有望启发下一代高性能镁合金的设计。
summary_zh: 通过铸造+固溶+挤压研制 Mg-11Y-1Al 合金，借助 Al₂O₃/Al(OH)₃ 沉积快速形成致密 Y₂O₃/Y(OH)₃ 保护膜，使腐蚀速率低于 0.2 mm/y、屈服强度达 350 MPa、延伸率 8%，晶粒细化、弱织构与非基面滑移共同贡献强度与塑性。

title_en: Design metastability in high-entropy alloys by tailoring unstable fault energies
abstract_en: Metastable alloys with transformation-/twinning-induced plasticity (TRIP/TWIP) can overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in structural materials. Originated from the development of traditional alloys, the intrinsic stacking fault energy (ISFE) has been applied to tailor TRIP/TWIP in high-entropy alloys (HEAs) but with limited quantitative success. Here, we demonstrate a strategy for designing metastable HEAs and validate its effectiveness by discovering seven alloys with experimentally observed metastability for TRIP/TWIP. We propose unstable fault energies as the more effective design metric and attribute the deformation mechanism of metastable face-centered cubic alloys to unstable martensite fault energy (UMFE)/unstable twin fault energy (UTFE) rather than ISFE. Among the studied HEAs and steels, the traditional ISFE criterion fails in more than half of the cases, while the UMFE/UTFE criterion accurately predicts the deformation mechanisms in all cases. The UMFE/UTFE criterion provides an effective paradigm for developing metastable alloys with TRIP/TWIP for an enhanced strength-ductility synergy.
title_zh: 通过调控不稳定层错能设计高熵合金中的亚稳态
abstract_zh: 具相变/孪生诱导塑性(TRIP/TWIP)的亚稳合金可克服结构材料的强度-塑性折衷。源自传统合金的发展，本征层错能(ISFE)已被用于调控高熵合金(HEA)中的 TRIP/TWIP，但定量成效有限。本文展示了一种设计亚稳高熵合金的策略，并通过发现七种实验观测到具 TRIP/TWIP 亚稳性的合金验证其有效性。我们提出不稳定层错能是更有效的设计判据，并将亚稳面心立方合金的变形机制归因于不稳定马氏体层错能(UMFE)/不稳定孪晶层错能(UTFE)而非 ISFE。在所研究的高熵合金与钢中，传统 ISFE 判据在过半案例中失效，而 UMFE/UTFE 判据在所有案例中都准确预测了变形机制。UMFE/UTFE 判据为开发具 TRIP/TWIP 的亚稳合金以增强强度-塑性协同提供了有效范式。
summary_zh: 提出以不稳定马氏体/孪晶层错能(UMFE/UTFE)取代本征层错能作为更有效的亚稳态设计判据，据此发现七种具 TRIP/TWIP 亚稳性的高熵合金，该判据在所有案例中准确预测变形机制而传统 ISFE 过半失效。

title_en: On the origins of fatigue strength in crystalline metallic materials
abstract_en: Metallic materials experience irreversible deformation with increasing applied stress, manifested in localized slip events that result in fatigue failure upon repeated cycling. We discerned the physical origins of fatigue strength in a large set of face-centered cubic, hexagonal close-packed, and body-centered cubic metallic materials by considering cyclic deformation processes at nanometer resolution over large volumes of individual materials at the earliest stages of cycling. We identified quantitative relations between the yield strength and the ultimate tensile strength, fatigue strength, and physical characteristics of early slip localization events. The fatigue strength of metallic alloys that deform by slip could be predicted by the amplitude of slip localization during the first cycle of loading. Our observations provide a physical basis for well-known empirical fatigue laws and enable a rapid method of predicting fatigue strength as reflected by measurement of slip localization amplitude.

title_zh: 论晶态金属材料疲劳强度的起源
abstract_zh: 金属材料随施加应力增大经历不可逆变形，表现为局部滑移事件，在反复循环下导致疲劳失效。我们通过在循环最早期、以纳米分辨率对大量单个材料的大体积进行考察，辨明了一大组面心立方、密排六方与体心立方金属材料中疲劳强度的物理起源。我们确定了屈服强度与抗拉强度、疲劳强度及早期滑移局部化事件物理特征之间的定量关系。以滑移变形的金属合金的疲劳强度可由首次加载循环期间滑移局部化的幅度来预测。我们的观察为众所周知的经验疲劳定律提供了物理基础，并使一种通过测量滑移局部化幅度快速预测疲劳强度的方法成为可能。
summary_zh: 通过纳米分辨率大体积观测 FCC/HCP/BCC 金属循环加载最初阶段的滑移局部化，建立屈服强度、抗拉强度、疲劳强度与早期滑移局部化特征的定量关系，提出可由首次加载循环的滑移局部化幅度预测疲劳强度，为经验疲劳定律提供物理基础。
